title.en: Does the Inertia of a Body Depend upon its Energy-Content?

edition.zh:
采用 W. Perrett / G. B. Jeffery 1923 年英译、John Walker 于 2001 年制作的 Fourmilab 电子版，收录该版论文全部正文及脚注。
英译本以 c 表示光速；德文原刊以 V 表示光速。物理含义一致。
英文正文保留历史排法“L/9 × 10²⁰”。根据 L/c²，其分母应读作 9 × 10²⁰（约 3 × 10¹⁰ cm/s 的平方）；中文显式加括号以消除歧义。
论文正文没有单独写出今天常用的 E = mc²；正文给出质量变化关系，并以文字提出更广泛的结论。
原刊脚注1为前文书目；英译以链接承接。原刊署“伯尔尼，1905年9月”，9月27日为收稿日期。
edition.en:
Complete paper body and its footnote, using the W. Perrett / G. B. Jeffery English translation (1923), as transcribed by John Walker for Fourmilab (2001).
The English edition uses c for the speed of light; the original German paper uses V. The physical meaning is unchanged.
The historical notation “L/9 × 10²⁰” is preserved in the English reading text. Its intended denominator is 9 × 10²⁰ (the square of approximately 3 × 10¹⁰ cm/s), not 9 followed by multiplication outside the denominator. The Chinese text makes these parentheses explicit.
The familiar standalone equation E = mc² does not occur verbatim in this paper body. The paper states a change-of-mass relation and a broader verbal conclusion.
Original footnote 1 supplies the earlier-paper reference, represented by a link in the English edition. The original is dated Bern, September 1905; September 27 is the receipt date.

scope.en: From “The results of the previous investigation” through “the emitting and absorbing bodies”, plus the single asterisk footnote. Includes all six displayed equation groups. Excludes Fourmilab’s “About this Edition/Document” editorial text and navigation.

segments.en: The results of the previous investigation lead to a very interesting conclusion, which is here to be deduced.
segments.zh: 此前研究的结果导向一个很有意思的结论，下面就来推导这一结论。

segments.en: I based that investigation on the Maxwell-Hertz equations for empty space,
segments.zh: 那项研究以真空中的麦克斯韦—赫兹方程为基础，

segments.en: together with the Maxwellian expression for the electromagnetic energy of space,
segments.zh: 同时采用麦克斯韦关于空间中电磁能量的表达式，

segments.en: and in addition the principle that:—
segments.zh: 并且采用如下原理：

segments.en: The laws by which the states of physical systems alter are independent of the alternative, to which of two systems of coordinates, in uniform motion of parallel translation relatively to each other, these alterations of state are referred (principle of relativity).
segments.zh: 对于两个彼此作匀速平移的坐标系，无论把物理系统的状态变化归于哪一个坐标系来描述，支配这种变化的定律都相同（相对性原理）。

segments.en: With these principles* as my basis I deduced inter alia the following result (§ 8):—
segments.zh: 以这些原理*为基础，我曾推导出若干结果，其中包括以下结果（第 8 节）：

segments.en: Let a system of plane waves of light, referred to the system of co-ordinates (x, y, z), possess the energy l; let the direction of the ray (the wave-normal) make an angle φ with the axis of x of the system.
segments.zh: 设一组平面光波相对于坐标系 (x, y, z) 的能量为 l；光线方向（波面法线）与该坐标系的 x 轴夹角为 φ。

segments.en: If we introduce a new system of co-ordinates (ξ, η, ζ) moving in uniform parallel translation with respect to the system (x, y, z), and having its origin of co-ordinates in motion along the axis of x with the velocity v,
segments.zh: 若引入一个相对于 (x, y, z) 作匀速平移的新坐标系 (ξ, η, ζ)，其坐标原点以速度 v 沿 x 轴运动，

segments.en: then this quantity of light—measured in the system (ξ, η, ζ)—possesses the energy
segments.zh: 则这束光在 (ξ, η, ζ) 系中测得的能量为

segments.zh: l* = l(1 − (v/c) cos φ)/√(1 − v²/c²)

segments.en: where c denotes the velocity of light. We shall make use of this result in what follows.
segments.zh: 其中 c 表示光速。下文将使用这一结果。

segments.en: Let there be a stationary body in the system (x, y, z), and let its energy—referred to the system (x, y, z) be E₀.
segments.zh: 设有一个在 (x, y, z) 系中静止的物体，其相对于 (x, y, z) 系的能量为 E₀。

segments.en: Let the energy of the body relative to the system (ξ, η, ζ) moving as above with the velocity v, be H₀.
segments.zh: 令该物体相对于上述以速度 v 运动的 (ξ, η, ζ) 系的能量为 H₀。

segments.en: Let this body send out, in a direction making an angle φ with the axis of x, plane waves of light, of energy ½L measured relatively to (x, y, z), and simultaneously an equal quantity of light in the opposite direction.
segments.zh: 令该物体沿与 x 轴夹角为 φ 的方向发出平面光波，其相对于 (x, y, z) 系测得的能量为 ½L，同时沿相反方向发出等量的光。

segments.en: Meanwhile the body remains at rest with respect to the system (x, y, z).
segments.zh: 在此过程中，物体相对于 (x, y, z) 系保持静止。

segments.en: The principle of energy must apply to this process, and in fact (by the principle of relativity) with respect to both systems of co-ordinates.
segments.zh: 能量原理必须适用于这一过程；实际上，根据相对性原理，它必须在两个坐标系中都适用。

segments.zh: 物体相对于 (ξ, η, ζ) 系的动能因发光而减小，

segments.en: If a body gives off the energy L in the form of radiation, its mass diminishes by L/c².
segments.zh: 如果物体以辐射形式放出能量 L，它的质量就减小 L/c²。

segments.en: The fact that the energy withdrawn from the body becomes energy of radiation evidently makes no difference, so that we are led to the more general conclusion that
segments.zh: 从物体取出的能量恰好转变为辐射能，这一点显然无关紧要；因此我们得到一个更普遍的结论：

segments.en: The mass of a body is a measure of its energy-content;
segments.zh: 物体的质量是其所含能量的量度；

segments.en: if the energy changes by L, the mass changes in the same sense by L/9 × 10²⁰, the energy being measured in ergs, and the mass in grammes.
segments.zh: 如果能量变化 L，质量就沿同一方向变化 L/(9 × 10²⁰)，这里能量以尔格计，质量以克计。

segments.en: It is not impossible that with bodies whose energy-content is variable to a high degree (e.g. with radium salts) the theory may be successfully put to the test.
segments.zh: 对于所含能量能够发生很大变化的物体（例如镭盐），或许有可能成功地检验这一理论。

segments.en: If the theory corresponds to the facts, radiation conveys inertia between the emitting and absorbing bodies.
segments.zh: 如果这一理论与事实相符，那么辐射就在发射物体和吸收物体之间传递惯性。

segments.en: * The principle of the constancy of the velocity of light is of course contained in Maxwell's equations.
segments.zh: * 光速恒定原理当然已包含在麦克斯韦方程中。

title.zh: 从光的能量追到物体的惯性
title.en: From light energy to the body’s inertia

summary.zh: 作者从自己先前算出的光能量变换出发，研究物体发光以后，质量会怎样改变。
summary.en: The author starts with his earlier calculation of light energy in different frames and uses it to investigate how emission changes the body’s mass.

reasoning.zh: 德文脚注为 Ann. \(d\). Phys. 17, \(p\). 891 (1905)。Fourmilab 把该书目脚注转为开头的链接。
reasoning.en: The German footnote gives Ann. \(d\). Phys. 17, \(p\). 891 (1905). Fourmilab renders it as the opening hyperlink.

why.zh: 光带走多少能量，就决定物体少掉多少能量；把同一次发光在两个运动状态不同的观察者那里分别算一遍，可以进一步联系到物体的动能和惯性。
why.en: The energy carried away by light determines the body’s energy loss. Accounting for the same emission from two states of motion connects that loss to the body’s kinetic energy and inertia.

text.zh: 这里的“惯性”指物体抵抗速度改变的程度，在低速力学中用质量来衡量。动能公式 \(K=\tfrac12 mv^2\) 提供了一条联系：若能比较同一速度下物体发光前后的动能，就能从乘在 \(v^2\) 前面的系数看出质量是否变化。短文要建立的，正是从发出的光能走到这种比较的推导。
text.en: “Inertia” means resistance to a change of velocity; in low-speed mechanics it is measured by mass. The formula \(K=\tfrac12 mv^2\) supplies a connection: comparing the body’s kinetic energies before and after emission at the same speed reveals whether the coefficient of \(v^2\), and hence its mass, changes. The note aims to connect emitted light energy to that comparison.

text.zh: 所需的输入来自《动体电动力学》第 8 节：同一包光在两套彼此匀速运动的测量系统中，可以有不同的总能量。那一节已经根据电磁场和空间体积的变换，给出了两种能量读数的比例。短文可以直接使用这个结果，计算另一位观察者认为光带走了多少能量。
text.en: The required input comes from section 8 of On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies: the same packet of light can have different total energies in two measuring systems in uniform relative motion. That section calculates their ratio from the transformed electromagnetic fields and spatial volume. The note can use it to determine how much energy the other observer assigns to the emitted light.

text.zh: 作者让物体同时向两侧发出等量的光，并规定它在原系中保持静止。这样，另一位匀速运动的观察者也会在发光前后看到物体具有相同的速度。双方各自应用能量守恒，便得到可比较的两条能量变化关系；短文随后把它们联系到动能。原刊第 639 页的脚注确实指向这篇前作，因此开头的“此前研究”有明确出处。
text.en: The body emits equal amounts of light simultaneously in opposite directions and remains at rest in the original frame. The uniformly moving observer therefore also sees the same body speed before and after emission. Applying conservation separately gives two energy-change relations that the note then connects to kinetic energy. The footnote on original page 639 identifies the earlier paper, fixing the meaning of “the previous investigation.”

limits.zh: Maxwell 方程在一个系中给出传播速度；每个惯性系都采用同一形式，还用到了相对性原理。这里只处理真空，不套用于介质中的相速度。
limits.en: Maxwell equations specify propagation speed in a frame; using the same form in every inertial frame also requires relativity. This branch concerns vacuum, not a material medium’s phase velocity.

why.zh: 电场与磁场的变化相互联系；将两个变化方程合并，就得到一个波动方程，而其中的系数固定了波速。
why.en: Changes in electric and magnetic fields are coupled. Combining their equations gives a wave equation whose coefficient fixes the wave speed.

text.zh: 电场描述电荷在各处受到的电作用，磁场描述磁作用。Maxwell–Hertz 方程规定这两种场怎样随位置和时间变化。在没有电荷和电流的真空区域，变化中的两种场仍然能够彼此联系，从而形成向外传播的电磁扰动。本文接受这套场定律，再推导它对光的后果。
text.en: An electric field describes electrical action on charges at different locations; a magnetic field describes magnetic action. The Maxwell–Hertz equations specify how these fields vary in space and time. Even in a vacuum region without charges or currents, their changes remain coupled and allow electromagnetic disturbances to propagate. The paper adopts these field laws and derives their consequences for light.

text.zh: 完整合并两组场方程需要多元微积分；这里采用来源中已经推出的一维结果：\[\frac{\partial^2\mathcal E}{\partial t^2}=c^2\frac{\partial^2\mathcal E}{\partial x^2}.\]其中 \(\mathcal E\) 是电场的一个分量；后文用于物体能量的 \(E\) 是另一种量。这里 \(x\) 是传播方向上的位置，\(t\) 是时间。两边的二阶导数分别描述它在时间和空间上的弯曲程度；\(c^2\) 规定两者的比例。这个公式就是波动方程。
text.en: Combining the full field equations requires multivariable calculus. Here we take their documented one-dimensional result as an input: \[\frac{\partial^2\mathcal E}{\partial t^2}=c^2\frac{\partial^2\mathcal E}{\partial x^2}.\]Here \(\mathcal E\) is one electric-field component, distinct from the body energy later called \(E\); \(x\) is position along propagation, and \(t\) is time. The second derivatives describe the field’s curvature in time and in space; \(c^2\) fixes their ratio. This is a wave equation.

heading.en: From field laws to a wave equation

text.zh: 可以用一个具体波形读出这个系数的含义。取 \(\mathcal E=A\cos(kx-\omega t)\)，并令 \(k,\omega>0\)：\(A\) 是最大场强，\(k\) 表示每单位距离改变多少角度，\(\omega\) 表示每单位时间改变多少角度。余弦函数分别对时间和位置求两次变化率，会得到 \(-\omega^2\mathcal E\) 和 \(-k^2\mathcal E\)。代入上式并约去共同的波形因子，便有 \[\omega^2=c^2k^2.\]
text.en: A concrete wave shows what the coefficient means. Take \(\mathcal E=A\cos(kx-\omega t)\) with \(k,\omega>0\): \(A\) is the maximum field strength, \(k\) gives the angle change per unit distance, and \(\omega\) the angle change per unit time. Differentiating the cosine twice in time or position gives \(-\omega^2\mathcal E\) or \(-k^2\mathcal E\). Substitution and cancellation of the common wave factor give \[\omega^2=c^2k^2.\]

text.zh: 跟着一个波峰移动时，余弦括号内的角度保持不变，所以 \(k\Delta x-\omega\Delta t=0\)。移项、除以 \(k\Delta t\)，波峰速度就是 \[\frac{\Delta x}{\Delta t}=\frac{\omega}{k}=c.\]因此，场方程中的系数确实给出了波的传播速度，而不只是一个无从解释的常数。
text.en: To follow one crest, keep the angle inside the cosine fixed: \(k\Delta x-\omega\Delta t=0\). Rearranging and dividing by \(k\Delta t\) gives the crest speed: \[\frac{\Delta x}{\Delta t}=\frac{\omega}{k}=c.\]Thus the coefficient in the field equation specifies the propagation speed of the wave.

text.zh: 这先说明一套坐标中的波速。要让彼此匀速运动的两位观察者都采用相同的真空场方程和同一个 \(c\)，还用到本文明确提出的相对性原理。后续光能量的比较，是在这些物理前提上进行的。
text.en: This first establishes the wave speed within one coordinate system. Requiring two uniformly moving observers to use the same vacuum equations and the same \(c\) also uses the stated relativity principle. The later light-energy comparison proceeds on those physical premises.

title.zh: 从做功到光的总能量
title.en: From work to the total energy of light

summary.zh: 光的能量储存在电场和磁场中。知道每单位体积含多少能量，再把整包光所占的空间加起来，就能得到总能量。
summary.en: Light’s energy is stored in its electric and magnetic fields. Find the energy per unit volume and add it over the packet to obtain the total.

reasoning.zh: Maxwell §71 把电流与势的能量写成体积分，分部积分后得到磁场能量 \(\frac{\mu I^2}{8\pi}\)。
reasoning.en: Maxwell §71 writes the current-potential energy as a volume integral; integration by parts gives magnetic energy density \(\frac{\mu I^2}{8\pi}\).

reasoning.zh: §72 从做功 \(\int P\,\mathrm{d}f\) 及线性关系 \(P=kf\) 得 \(\frac12 Pf\)，三方向相加得电储能。
reasoning.en: Section 72 uses work \(\int P\,\mathrm{d}f\) and \(P=kf\) to obtain \(\frac12 Pf\), then adds the three directions for electric storage.

reasoning.zh: 采用现代真空 Gaussian 单位，瞬时总场能密度为 \(\frac{|E|^2+|B|^2}{8\pi}\)；平面简谐波满足 \(|E|=|B|\)，周期平均得到 \(\frac{A^2}{8\pi}\)。
reasoning.en: In modern vacuum Gaussian units the instantaneous total density is \(\frac{|E|^2+|B|^2}{8\pi}\). A sinusoidal plane wave has \(|E|=|B|\), giving cycle-average \(\frac{A^2}{8\pi}\).

limits.zh: 振幅 \(A\)、瞬时量和周期平均量应采用一致约定。Maxwell 的机械介质解释不是本数据额外采纳的前提。
limits.en: Amplitude, instantaneous quantities, and cycle averages require a consistent convention. Maxwell’s mechanical-medium interpretation is not an additional premise adopted here.

why.zh: Maxwell 从建立场所需的功得到储能公式；对本文的平面波，能量密度随场振幅的平方变化。
why.en: Maxwell obtains field energy from the work needed to establish the fields. For the plane wave used here, energy density scales with amplitude squared.

text.zh: 能量为什么可以记在“场”上，可以从功来理解：逐渐建立一个电场需要做功，这些功被计入所建立的场能。Maxwell 对电场采用线性的作用与响应关系，将逐步建立场所需的功累加；磁场的储能也有相应的计算。这给光的电磁场提供了可计算的能量。
text.en: Work explains why energy can be assigned to a field. Gradually establishing an electric field requires work, which is accounted for as stored field energy. Maxwell uses a linear relation between electrical action and response and accumulates the work required to build the field. A corresponding calculation gives magnetic field energy, making the energy of light’s fields calculable.

text.zh: 平方可以用熟悉的线性做功关系理解。假设力随位移增大，满足 \(F=kx\)，其中 \(k\) 是固定比例。\(F-x\) 图下是一块三角形，做功为 \[W=\frac12 x\,(kx)=\frac12 kx^2.\]位移加倍，图的底和高都加倍，功便成为四倍。这个例子说明线性关系经累积为什么产生平方；Maxwell 对场的作用与响应做同类的累积，得到实际的电磁储能式。
text.en: A familiar linear work relation explains the square. Suppose force increases with displacement as \(F=kx\), with fixed constant \(k\). The area under the \(F-x\) graph is a triangle, so the work is \[W=\frac12 x\,(kx)=\frac12 kx^2.\]Doubling displacement doubles both base and height, quadrupling the work. This example shows how accumulating a linear relation produces a square. Maxwell performs the corresponding accumulation for field action and response to obtain the electromagnetic energy expression.

text.zh: 把每单位体积的能量记为 \(u\)，称为“能量密度”；把波动中电场达到的最大强度记为 \(A\)，称为“振幅”。本文采用的平面波包含一起振荡的电场和磁场。将两者储能相加，再对一个周期取平均，按原文的单位约定得到 \[u=\frac{A^2}{8\pi}.\]后续最重要的是 \(u\) 与 \(A^2\) 成正比；\(8\pi\) 属于这套场单位和振幅约定。
text.en: Call energy per unit volume \(u\), the “energy density,” and the maximum oscillating electric-field strength \(A\), its “amplitude.” The paper’s plane wave contains electric and magnetic fields oscillating together. Adding their stored energies and averaging over one cycle gives, in the source’s unit convention, \[u=\frac{A^2}{8\pi}.\]The crucial feature is proportionality to \(A^2\); \(8\pi\) belongs to the field-unit and amplitude conventions.

text.zh: 最后，设被计入的光包体积为 \(S\)。对于这里采用的均匀平均能量密度，总光能就是 \(l=uS\)。因此，两位运动状态不同的观察者比较同一包光时，既要比较他们测得的场振幅，也要比较他们给这包光算出的体积。总能量变化由这两项共同决定。
text.en: Finally, let \(S\) be the volume of the light packet being counted. With the uniform average density used here, its total energy is \(l=uS\). Two observers in relative motion must therefore compare both their measured field amplitudes and the volumes they assign to the same packet. Both factors determine the change in total energy.

title.zh: 两个运动观察者共用物理定律
title.en: Two moving observers use the same laws

summary.zh: 两位彼此匀速运动的观察者，都可以使用同样的物理定律描述一次发光；本文把这称为相对性原理。
summary.en: Two observers in uniform relative motion may use the same physical laws to describe an emission. The paper calls this the relativity principle.

reasoning.zh: 选取相对速度为 \(v\) 的两个惯性系。
reasoning.en: Choose two inertial frames with relative velocity \(v\).

reasoning.zh: 要求描述同一过程的物理定律形式一致。
reasoning.en: Require the laws describing the same process to have the same form.

limits.zh: 1905 短文没有在此用实验重新证明相对性原理；物理前提应与代数推论分开显示。
limits.en: The 1905 note does not experimentally re-establish the relativity principle; physical premises must be displayed separately from algebraic consequences.

why.zh: 它让双方各自使用能量守恒与真空电磁定律；随后通过坐标和场的变换，把不同的测量读数联系起来。
why.en: It lets each observer use energy conservation and vacuum electromagnetic laws, with coordinate and field transformations relating their different readings.

text.zh: “参考系”可以理解为一套用来记录位置的尺和用来记录时间的钟；它给同一个事件标上地点和时刻。惯性系是满足牛顿第一定律的参考系：合外力为零的物体在其中保持静止或匀速直线运动。本文选择两套彼此匀速运动的惯性系来描述同一次发光。
text.en: A “reference frame” is a system of rulers for positions and clocks for times: it assigns a place and a time to an event. An inertial frame obeys Newton’s first law: a body with no net force remains at rest or moves at constant velocity in it. The paper chooses two inertial frames in uniform relative motion to describe the same emission.

text.zh: “使用同样的定律”指双方写下的关系形式相同。例如，两边都要求某次过程的初始总能量等于最终总能量。它并不要求双方对每一项能量报出同一个数：物体相对两套尺和钟的运动不同，其动能以及光的能量读数可以不同。这篇短文正要利用这些读数之间的关系。
text.en: “Using the same laws” means writing relations of the same form. For example, both require the initial total energy of a process to equal its final total energy. This does not require identical values for every energy: motion relative to the two systems differs, and so can kinetic and light energies. The note uses the relations between those readings.

text.zh: 具体做法是：双方先各自写能量守恒，再用经过推导的光能量变换，把其中的光能联系起来。相对性原理提供“两边都能这样算”的许可；坐标与场的变换提供“数值怎样对应”的规则。这里的相对性原理是明确采用的物理前提，后面的代数结论由它和其他前提一起推出。
text.en: In practice, each observer first writes an energy balance. The derived light-energy transformation then relates the light terms in those balances. Relativity permits both calculations; the coordinate and field transformations specify how their values correspond. The relativity principle is an adopted physical premise, from which the later algebra follows together with the other premises.

title.zh: 这一引用提供了什么计算
title.en: What the cited calculation supplies

summary.zh: 被引论文第 8 节提供了同一包光在两个运动参考系中的总能量比例，短文用它来计算发光带走的能量。
summary.en: Section 8 of the cited paper supplies the total-energy ratio for the same light packet in two moving frames. The note uses it to calculate the energy carried away.

reasoning.zh: 总能量 \(l=uS\)，而 \(l^\ast=u^\prime S^\prime\)。
reasoning.en: Total energies are \(l=uS\) and \(l^\ast=u^\prime S^\prime\).

reasoning.zh: 合并 \(\frac{u^\prime}{u}=D^2\) 和 \(\frac{S^\prime}{S}=\frac1D\)，得 \(\frac{l^\ast}{l}=D\)。
reasoning.en: Combine \(\frac{u^\prime}{u}=D^2\) with \(\frac{S^\prime}{S}=\frac1D\) to obtain \(\frac{l^\ast}{l}=D\).

reasoning.zh: 全程使用经典电磁平面波；不需要引入光子或 \(E=h\nu\)。
reasoning.en: This uses classical electromagnetic plane waves throughout; photons or \(E=h\nu\) are not required.

limits.zh: \(\phi\) 在发射体静止系测量；\(|v|<c\)。式中的 \(l^\ast\) 是另一参考系测得的能量。
limits.en: The angle \(\phi\) is measured in the emitter-rest frame and \(|v|<c\). The starred energy is the other frame’s measurement.

why.zh: 该节把场强的变化和光包体积的变化相乘，完成了从局部场能到总光能的计算；公式与短文使用的结果一致。
why.en: That section combines the changes in field strength and packet volume, completing the calculation from local field energy to total light energy. Its result matches the formula used in the note.

text.zh: 这一处引用需要提供的具体东西，是同一包光在另一套匀速运动的尺和钟那里会有多少能量。“同一包”意味着圈定并跟随同一部分光；否则拿不同数量的光来比较，能量当然也会不同。第 8 节正是对同一个随光移动的区域进行计算。
text.en: The citation must supply something specific: the energy assigned to the same packet by another uniformly moving system of rulers and clocks. “The same packet” means selecting and following the same portion of light. Comparing different amounts of light would change the energy for a separate reason. Section 8 calculates for one region followed along with the light.

text.zh: 计算先用 \(l=uS\)：\(l\) 是总光能，\(u\) 是每单位体积的平均能量，\(S\) 是光包体积。另一系的量加一撇，所以 \(l^\ast=u'S'\)。两式相除，就把问题拆成两个可分别计算的比例：\[\frac{l^\ast}{l}=\frac{u'}{u}\frac{S'}{S}.\]这里相乘的原因，就是总能量本来由密度乘体积得到。
text.en: Start with \(l=uS\): \(l\) is total light energy, \(u\) is average energy per unit volume, and \(S\) is packet volume. Primes mark the other frame, so \(l^\ast=u'S'\). Dividing separates the problem into two calculable ratios: \[\frac{l^\ast}{l}=\frac{u'}{u}\frac{S'}{S}.\]They are multiplied because total energy itself is density times volume.

text.zh: 前作第 6、7 节给出了电磁场在运动观察下的变化。把场振幅的变化倍数暂记为 \(D\)，就是 \(A'=DA\)，其中振幅 \(A\) 表示最大场强。由于能量密度与振幅平方成正比，便有 \(u'/u=D^2\)。第 8 节再把同一光包按另一系的“同一时刻”量体积，得到 \(S'/S=1/D\)；场变换和体积计算是这里两个有明确出处的输入。
text.en: Sections 6 and 7 give the electromagnetic-field change for a moving observer. Write the amplitude factor as \(D\), so \(A'=DA\), where amplitude \(A\) means maximum field strength. Since density is proportional to amplitude squared, \(u'/u=D^2\). Section 8 measures the same packet on a simultaneous slice in the other frame and obtains \(S'/S=1/D\). These field and volume calculations are the two explicitly sourced inputs.

text.zh: 代回两个比例，总能量比便是 \(D^2\times(1/D)=D\)。因此，场振幅的变化倍数也恰好成为这一个光包的总能量变化倍数。原文紧接着写出的长公式，就是把 \(D\) 展开为相对速度和传播角的函数；这一引用已经提供了那项计算，短文随后才能把它用于两束反向发出的光。
text.en: Substitution gives a total-energy ratio \(D^2\times(1/D)=D\). The amplitude factor thus also becomes the total-energy factor for this packet. The longer formula immediately following the citation writes \(D\) as a function of relative speed and propagation angle. With that calculation supplied, the note can apply it to two oppositely emitted beams.

title.zh: 把光束的形状、范围和方向说清楚
title.en: Specifying the wave, packet, and direction

summary.zh: 作者选取一包平面光波，规定它在原坐标系中的能量和传播方向，为两系能量比较固定同一个对象。
summary.en: The author selects a packet of plane light waves and specifies its energy and direction in the original frame, fixing the object compared between frames.

reasoning.zh: 这些条件定义要解决的思想实验，不是测量得到的样品事实；Lorentz变换取\(|v|<c\)。
reasoning.en: These define the thought experiment rather than measured sample properties; the Lorentz transformation requires \(|v|<c\).

why.zh: 平面波让传播方向有明确含义；圈定同一包光固定了光的数量；角度则决定相对运动如何影响能量读数。
why.en: A plane wave has a definite propagation direction, selecting a packet fixes the light being counted, and the angle determines how relative motion affects its energy.

text.zh: “平面波”描述光波的形状：在同一时刻，同时处于波峰位置的点组成一张平面，这样的平面一层层向前移动。垂直于这些平面的方向，就是传播方向。原文括号里的“波面法线”，指的正是这条垂直方向。
text.en: A “plane wave” describes the wave’s shape: at one time, the points at a crest form a plane, and successive parallel planes move forward. The direction perpendicular to those planes is the propagation direction. That is what the text means by the “wave-normal.”

text.zh: 总能量还需要明确空间范围。前作的办法是圈定随光一起移动的一部分，并比较这一包光在两系中的能量；把原系测得的值记为小写 \(l\)。平面波规定的是这包光采用的波形，随光移动的边界则规定要把哪部分能量加进来。
text.en: Total energy also needs a spatial extent. The earlier paper selects a portion moving with the light and compares that packet in both frames; its original-frame energy is lowercase \(l\). The plane wave specifies the wave pattern, while the moving boundary specifies which portion of its energy is counted.

text.zh: 随后把两套坐标系的相对运动方向选作 \(x\) 轴，并用 \(\phi\) 表示光线与这条轴的夹角。按直角三角形的投影关系，光速沿 \(x\) 方向的分量是 \(c\cos\phi\)，其中 \(c\) 是光速。这解释了为什么后续变换中会出现 \(\cos\phi\)：它记录光沿观察者运动方向传播的那一部分。这里的角度始终在原系中测量。
text.en: The relative motion of the frames is chosen as the \(x\) direction, and \(\phi\) is the angle between the ray and that axis. The right-triangle projection of light speed onto \(x\) is \(c\cos\phi\), with \(c\) the speed of light. This explains the later \(\cos\phi\): it records the component of propagation along the observer’s motion. The angle is always measured in the original frame.

title.zh: 第二套尺和钟怎样运动
title.en: How the second system of rulers and clocks moves

summary.zh: 本文让第二套坐标沿第一套的一个方向匀速运动，再用同一事件在两套尺和钟上的读数来比较能量。
summary.en: The second frame moves uniformly along one axis of the first. Energy is compared using the two systems’ position and time readings for the same events.

reasoning.zh: 这些条件定义要解决的思想实验，不是测量得到的样品事实；Lorentz变换取\(|v|<c\)。
reasoning.en: These define the thought experiment rather than measured sample properties; the Lorentz transformation requires \(|v|<c\).

why.zh: 相对速度固定了位置和时间应怎样一起变换；这套变换使双方都测得相同的真空光速，并用于后续电磁场计算。
why.en: The relative speed fixes the joint transformation of position and time. It preserves the vacuum light speed for both frames and supplies the later field calculation.

text.zh: 把一套位置标尺和同步时钟称为甲系，把另一套称为乙系。“同步”是规定散布在同一系各处的钟怎样对时。甲系记位置和时间为 \(x,t\)，乙系记为 \(x',t'\)；加撇只表示换了测量系统。原文用希腊字母表示乙系的坐标，这里用撇号便于比较。
text.en: Call one system of rulers and synchronized clocks frame A, and the other frame B. Synchronization specifies how clocks at different places in one frame are set together. A records position and time as \(x,t\), B as \(x',t'\); a prime simply marks the other measuring system. The original uses Greek letters for B’s spatial coordinates; primes make the comparison easier here.

text.zh: 作者规定乙系的原点沿甲系的 \(x\) 轴以速度 \(v\) 运动。把两原点相遇时设为各自的零时刻，于是在甲系中这个原点满足 \(x=vt\)，在乙系自己看来却始终是 \(x'=0\)。选择匀速运动，使同一个 \(v\) 可以贯穿整个发光过程；取 \(|v|<c\)，其中 \(c\) 是真空光速。
text.en: The origin of B moves along A’s \(x\) axis at speed \(v\). Set both clocks to zero when their origins meet. A then describes that origin by \(x=vt\), while B always assigns it \(x'=0\). Uniform motion lets the same \(v\) apply throughout the emission. The domain is \(|v|<c\), where \(c\) is vacuum light speed.

text.zh: 还要同时规定时间怎样变换。Einstein 在前作第 1—3 节结合光信号对时、相同光速的要求以及时空对称性，得到以下输入结果，称为 Lorentz 变换：\[\begin{aligned}x'&=\gamma(x-vt),\\t'&=\gamma\left(t-\frac{vx}{c^2}\right),\\\gamma&=\frac1{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\]\(\gamma\) 只是由相对速度算出的倍数。式子说明，乙系怎样给事件标时间，也与事件发生的位置有关。
text.en: Time must be related as well. Sections 1–3 of the earlier paper combine light-signal clock setting, equal light speed, and spacetime symmetry to obtain this input result, the Lorentz transformation: \[\begin{aligned}x'&=\gamma(x-vt),\\t'&=\gamma\left(t-\frac{vx}{c^2}\right),\\\gamma&=\frac1{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\]Here \(\gamma\) is a factor determined by relative speed. The equations show that B’s time assigned to an event also depends on where it occurs.

heading.zh: 位置与时间要一起对应

text.zh: 可以检查它为什么适合本文。对沿正 \(x\) 方向行进的光，甲系有 \(x=ct\)。代入就得 \(x'=\gamma(c-v)t\) 和 \(t'=\gamma(1-v/c)t\)，所以 \[\frac{x'}{t'}=\frac{c-v}{1-v/c}=c.\]双方因此对同一束光得到同样的传播速度。之后把这套坐标变换代入电磁定律，就能求双方的场强和光能量读数。
text.en: A direct check shows why it fits this problem. For light along positive \(x\), A has \(x=ct\). Substitution gives \(x'=\gamma(c-v)t\) and \(t'=\gamma(1-v/c)t\), so \[\frac{x'}{t'}=\frac{c-v}{1-v/c}=c.\]Both frames therefore obtain the same propagation speed for that light. Substituting this coordinate transformation into the electromagnetic laws then relates their field strengths and light energies.

title.zh: 同一包光的两种能量读数
title.en: Two energy readings for the same light packet

summary.zh: 另一位匀速运动的观察者给同一包光测得的总能量，等于原能量乘以一个由相对速度和光线方向决定的因子。
summary.en: The uniformly moving observer assigns the same packet a total energy equal to the original energy times a factor set by relative speed and ray direction.

reasoning.zh: 总能量 \(l=uS\)，而 \(l^\ast=u^\prime S^\prime\)。
reasoning.en: Total energies are \(l=uS\) and \(l^\ast=u^\prime S^\prime\).

reasoning.zh: 合并 \(\frac{u^\prime}{u}=D^2\) 和 \(\frac{S^\prime}{S}=\frac1D\)，得 \(\frac{l^\ast}{l}=D\)。
reasoning.en: Combine \(\frac{u^\prime}{u}=D^2\) with \(\frac{S^\prime}{S}=\frac1D\) to obtain \(\frac{l^\ast}{l}=D\).

reasoning.zh: 全程使用经典电磁平面波；不需要引入光子或 \(E=h\nu\)。
reasoning.en: This uses classical electromagnetic plane waves throughout; photons or \(E=h\nu\) are not required.

limits.zh: \(\phi\) 在发射体静止系测量；\(|v|<c\)。式中的 \(l^\ast\) 是另一参考系测得的能量。
limits.en: The angle \(\phi\) is measured in the emitter-rest frame and \(|v|<c\). The starred energy is the other frame’s measurement.

why.zh: 总能量等于每单位体积的能量乘体积。换到运动系后，场强和同一光包的体积都改变；把这两部分算在一起，就得到原文的比例。
why.en: Total energy is energy per unit volume times volume. Changing frames alters both field strength and the volume of the same packet. Combining the two gives the stated ratio.

text.zh: 先固定所比较的东西：在平面光波中圈出随光移动的一部分，称为一个光包。甲、乙两套尺和钟彼此匀速运动，速度为 \(v\)；光线与运动方向的夹角为 \(\phi\)，在甲系中测量。我们要比较的是同一个光包的能量 \(l\) 与 \(l^\ast\)，不是在两处随意截取的两团光。
text.en: First fix what is being compared: select a portion of plane light waves and follow it as a packet. Two systems of rulers and clocks, A and B, move uniformly relative to each other at \(v\). The ray makes angle \(\phi\) with that motion, measured in A. We compare the energies \(l\) and \(l^\ast\) of this same packet, rather than two independently selected portions of light.

text.zh: 把平均每单位体积的场能记为 \(u\)，光包体积记为 \(S\)，总能量便是 \(l=uS\)。另一系的量加一撇：\(l^\ast=u'S'\)。能量密度来自电场与磁场的储能，对本文的平面波满足 \(u=A^2/(8\pi)\)，其中振幅 \(A\) 是电场的最大强度。由此得到 \[\frac{u'}{u}=\frac{(A')^2}{A^2}.\]分母的同一单位因子被约掉了，所以密度比只取决于振幅比。
text.en: Let \(u\) be average field energy per unit volume and \(S\) the packet volume, so \(l=uS\). Primes mark B’s quantities: \(l^\ast=u'S'\). Field energy comes from the electric and magnetic fields. For this plane wave, \(u=A^2/(8\pi)\), where amplitude \(A\) is the maximum electric-field strength. Hence \[\frac{u'}{u}=\frac{(A')^2}{A^2}.\]The common unit factor cancels, leaving the squared amplitude ratio.

heading.zh: 先算每单位体积的能量

text.zh: 这里采用一个有明确来源的电磁学输入：前作第 6、7 节把坐标变换代入真空场方程，算得振幅比 \(A'/A=D\)，其中 \[\begin{aligned}\beta&=\frac vc,\qquad \gamma=\frac1{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}},\\D&=\gamma(1-\beta\cos\phi).\end{aligned}\]这里 \(c\) 是真空光速，取 \(|v|<c\)；\(\beta\) 是相对速度占光速的比例，\(\gamma\) 和 \(D\) 都是没有单位的倍数。这一场变换结果使用相对性原理和真空电磁定律；代入上一段，立即得到 \(u'/u=D^2\)。
text.en: Now use an explicitly sourced electromagnetic input. Sections 6 and 7 substitute the coordinate transformation into the vacuum field equations and obtain \(A'/A=D\), where \[\begin{aligned}\beta&=\frac vc,\qquad \gamma=\frac1{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}},\\D&=\gamma(1-\beta\cos\phi).\end{aligned}\]Here \(c\) is vacuum light speed and \(|v|<c\); \(\beta\) is relative speed as a fraction of light speed; \(\gamma\) and \(D\) are dimensionless factors. This field result uses relativity and vacuum electromagnetic laws. Substituting it above gives \(u'/u=D^2\).

text.zh: 体积必须在某一个时刻测量：先确定光包各处“此刻”在哪里，才能把这些位置围成的空间算出来。两系的时间坐标也随位置一起变换，所以乙系认定同时发生的那些事件，在甲系不一定同时。为跟住同一包光，第 8 节用一个随光移动的球形边界圈定它；乙系在自己的同一时刻看到这个边界成为椭球。
text.en: Volume must be measured at one time: locate all parts of the packet “now,” then determine the space they enclose. Time transforms together with position, so events simultaneous in B need not be simultaneous in A. Section 8 follows the same packet by enclosing it in a sphere moving with the light; on B’s simultaneous slice, this boundary is an ellipsoid.

heading.en: Then, the volume of that same packet

text.zh: 体积比例可以用“切薄片”来理解。沿两系相对运动的 \(x\) 方向，光包球心以 \(c\cos\phi\) 移动，因此相对球心的坐标为 \(X=x-ct\cos\phi\)。在乙系选同一时刻 \(t'=0\)，有来源的逆坐标变换给出 \(x=\gamma x'\)、\(t=\gamma vx'/c^2\)，横向坐标则不缩放。代入可见 \[\begin{aligned}X&=\gamma x'-\frac{\gamma v x'}c\cos\phi\\&=\gamma(1-\beta\cos\phi)x'=Dx'.\end{aligned}\]也就是说，对应薄片沿运动方向的位置和间距，按这个 \(D\) 联系起来。
text.en: The volume ratio can be understood by slicing. Along the relative-motion direction \(x\), the packet’s sphere center moves at \(c\cos\phi\), so the coordinate relative to its center is \(X=x-ct\cos\phi\). On B’s common time \(t'=0\), the sourced inverse transformation gives \(x=\gamma x'\) and \(t=\gamma vx'/c^2\), with no rescaling of transverse coordinates. Substitution yields \[\begin{aligned}X&=\gamma x'-\frac{\gamma v x'}c\cos\phi\\&=\gamma(1-\beta\cos\phi)x'=Dx'.\end{aligned}\]Thus this factor relates the positions and separations of corresponding slices along the motion.

text.zh: 把球沿这个方向切成许多薄片。由于横向坐标不缩放，球心位置的差别只把对应圆片挪到另一个横向位置，半径和面积不变；而由 \(X=Dx'\)，同一小段 \(X\) 对应的乙系厚度要除以 \(D\)。薄片体积等于面积乘厚度，每片都变为原来的 \(1/D\)，相加便得 \(S'/S=1/D\)。这与原文的椭球体积计算一致。
text.en: Slice the sphere into thin layers along that direction. The transverse coordinates are not rescaled, so the center’s different position only shifts each corresponding disk sideways, preserving its radius and area. From \(X=Dx'\), a small interval in \(X\) corresponds to B’s thickness divided by \(D\). Each layer’s volume is area times thickness, so every layer contributes \(1/D\) of its original volume. Adding the layers gives \(S'/S=1/D\), the result of the source’s ellipsoid calculation.

text.zh: 现在两个所需比例都有了。因为总能量是密度乘体积，\[\begin{aligned}\frac{l^\ast}{l}&=\frac{u'}u\frac{S'}S\\&=D^2\frac1D=D,\\l^\ast&=l\,\frac{1-(v/c)\cos\phi}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\]这就是原文公式：场能密度带来一个平方倍数，同一光包的体积除去其中一个倍数，最后留下 \(D\)。
text.en: Both required ratios are now available. Since total energy is density times volume, \[\begin{aligned}\frac{l^\ast}{l}&=\frac{u'}u\frac{S'}S\\&=D^2\frac1D=D,\\l^\ast&=l\,\frac{1-(v/c)\cos\phi}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\]This is the stated formula: field-energy density supplies a squared factor, the volume of the same packet removes one factor, and \(D\) remains.

title.zh: 四个符号记录两系、两个状态
title.en: Four labels for two frames and two states

summary.zh: 四个能量符号都指同一个物体：字母区分观察系，下标区分发光前后。
summary.en: All four energy labels refer to the same body. The letter distinguishes the observing frame; the subscript distinguishes before and after emission.

reasoning.zh: 定义只规定符号和测量参考系。\(L\)是静止系发出的总光能，\(v\)是两系相对速度。
reasoning.en: These define notation and frames. \(L\) is total light energy emitted in the rest frame; \(v\) is relative frame speed.

why.zh: 这样，既能比较某一系中物体发光前后的能量，也能比较同一状态在两系中的能量，不会把两种差别混在一起。
why.en: This keeps two comparisons distinct: before versus after within one frame, and one state viewed from two frames.

text.zh: 先选一套和物体一起静止的尺和钟，称为静止系；另一套相对于它匀速运动。发光前，在静止系中记录的物体能量叫 \(E_0\)，运动系中记录的叫 \(H_0\)。这里记录的是物体的总能量；在一套坐标中静止，只说明它在这套坐标中没有整体平移动能。
text.en: Choose rulers and clocks at rest with the body, its rest frame, and another system moving uniformly relative to it. Before emission, call the body’s energy in the rest frame \(E_0\), and in the moving frame \(H_0\). These are total body energies. Being stationary in one frame means that it has no overall translational kinetic energy in that frame.

text.zh: 发光后，继续使用原来的两套尺和钟：静止系记 \(E_1\)，运动系记 \(H_1\)。所以“0 到 1”始终是同一次发光的前后，“\(E\) 到 \(H\)”始终是同一个物体换观察系。字母和下标各自只负责一个区别。
text.en: After emission, keep those same two measuring systems: the rest frame records \(E_1\), and the moving frame \(H_1\). Thus “0 to 1” always means before and after this emission, while “\(E\) to \(H\)” always means changing the frame used for the same body. Each part of the label tracks one distinction.

text.zh: 现在可以直接读懂后续差值。\(E_0-E_1\) 是静止系看到物体少掉的能量；\(H_0-H_1\) 是运动系看到的减少量。\(H_0-E_0\) 则固定发光前的状态，比较两系的总能量。这种跨系比较随后要与动能联系起来，所以必须一直保持这些符号的对象和时刻一致。
text.en: The later differences now have clear meanings. \(E_0-E_1\) is the body’s energy loss in the rest frame; \(H_0-H_1\) is its loss in the moving frame. In \(H_0-E_0\), the pre-emission state is held fixed and the total energies are compared across frames. That cross-frame comparison is later connected to kinetic energy, so the body and state attached to each label must stay consistent.

title.zh: 用对称发光固定物体的速度
title.en: Using symmetric emission to keep the speed fixed

summary.zh: 作者选择同时向相反方向发出等能量的两束光，让物体在失去能量时仍可保持静止。
summary.en: The author chooses equal-energy light emitted simultaneously in opposite directions, allowing the body to lose energy while remaining at rest.

reasoning.zh: 在原系，两束各有 \(\frac L2\)；总能量为 \(L\)。
reasoning.en: Each beam has \(\frac L2\) in the original frame, for total \(L\).

reasoning.zh: 新系中分别为 \(\frac L2\gamma(1-\beta\cos\phi)\) 与 \(\frac L2\gamma(1+\beta\cos\phi)\)。
reasoning.en: The new-frame beam energies are \(\frac L2\gamma(1-\beta\cos\phi)\) and \(\frac L2\gamma(1+\beta\cos\phi)\).

reasoning.zh: 相加消去角度项，得到总辐射能量 \(\gamma L\)。
reasoning.en: Adding cancels the angular terms, yielding total radiated energy \(\gamma L\).

limits.zh: 这是对称且无反冲的规定情形。单向发光会有反冲，不能原样套用同一个速度 \(v\) 的前后比较。
limits.en: This is the stipulated symmetric no-recoil case. One-direction emission produces recoil and cannot use the same before/after speed comparison unchanged.

why.zh: 对称发光能使两束光的动量相互抵消。这样比较发光前后，物体在同一观察系中的速度就保持不变，便于追踪能量减少如何影响惯性。
why.en: Symmetric emission makes the light momenta cancel. The body then has the same speed before and after in a given frame, allowing the argument to track how energy loss affects inertia.

text.zh: 发光当然会把能量带走，但通常还要考虑物体是否因发光而反冲——也就是朝光的反方向开始运动。若速度也变了，动能的变化就同时掺入了速度变化。这里作者选用对称的思想实验，让讨论保持在“同一速度、不同发光前后状态”的比较上。
text.en: Emission carries away energy, but one must also consider recoil: the body can move opposite the emitted light. If its speed changes, the kinetic-energy change also reflects that speed change. The symmetric thought experiment keeps the comparison at the same speed while the body’s pre- and post-emission states differ.

text.zh: 具体规定是：在和物体一起静止的坐标系中，它同时向相反方向各发出能量 \(L/2\)。符号 \(L\) 就是这个系中发出的总光能，因为 \[\frac L2+\frac L2=L.\]“等能量”和“同时”都在这个指定的静止系中表述。
text.en: Specifically, in the frame at rest with the body it emits energy \(L/2\) simultaneously in each of two opposite directions. The symbol \(L\) is the total light energy emitted in that frame, because \[\frac L2+\frac L2=L.\]Both “equal energy” and “simultaneous” refer to this specified rest frame.

text.zh: 用已有的光动量关系可以解释这个安排：能量为 \(E_{\rm light}\) 的光携带大小为 \(p=E_{\rm light}/c\) 的动量，\(c\) 是光速。本文两束光各有大小 \(L/(2c)\) 的动量，方向相反，所以它们的总动量为零。物体无需用反冲去补偿一个净光动量，因而可以保持静止。原短文直接规定这一结果；后来的动量论证补出了这层解释。
text.en: The existing light-momentum relation explains the arrangement: light of energy \(E_{\rm light}\) carries momentum magnitude \(p=E_{\rm light}/c\), where \(c\) is light speed. Each beam here carries magnitude \(L/(2c)\) in opposite directions, giving zero total momentum. The body therefore needs no recoil to balance a net light momentum and can remain at rest. The note stipulates this result; the later momentum argument supplies the explanation.

text.zh: 既然物体在原系中发光前后都静止，另一位相对于原系匀速运动的观察者，也会在两次都看到同样大小的物体速度。这样，后续把动能差与低速公式 \(K=\tfrac12 mv^2\) 比较时，\(v\) 这一项被固定住了。对称发光的作用，就是为这种比较准备一个清楚的物理过程。
text.en: Because the body is at rest in the original frame both before and after, an observer moving uniformly relative to that frame sees the same body speed on both occasions. When the kinetic-energy difference is later compared with the low-speed formula \(K=\tfrac12 mv^2\), \(v\) is therefore held fixed. Symmetric emission provides a definite physical process for that comparison.

title.zh: 两束反向的光为什么不让物体反冲？
title.en: Why opposite beams leave the body at rest

summary.zh: 两束光在物体静止的参考系中能量相等、方向相反，带走的总动量为零，因此这个对称发光过程可以让物体继续静止。
summary.en: In the body’s rest frame, the equal-energy beams travel in opposite directions and carry zero total momentum. This symmetric emission can therefore leave the body at rest.

reasoning.zh: 原文明确说物体在原系仍静止；这是整个前后同速度比较的关键条件。
reasoning.en: The note explicitly keeps the body at rest in the original frame, enabling a same-speed before/after comparison.

reasoning.zh: 以\(p=\frac Ec\)描述每束光，两个动量大小相同、方向相反，总和为零。该动量解释属于本例补充，原短文未逐式展开。
reasoning.en: Using \(p=\frac Ec\), the two equal and opposite momenta cancel. This momentum explanation is supplemental; the note does not spell it out.

limits.zh: 这是对称且无反冲的规定情形。单向发光会有反冲，不能原样套用同一个速度 \(v\) 的前后比较。
limits.en: This is the stipulated symmetric no-recoil case. One-direction emission produces recoil and cannot use the same before/after speed comparison unchanged.

why.zh: 光携带动量，物体通常要通过反冲来补偿发出光的动量；这里两束光的动量已经彼此抵消。
why.en: Light carries momentum, which would ordinarily need to be balanced by recoil of the emitter. Here the two beam momenta cancel each other.

text.zh: 先说明这个设定想固定什么：物体同时向两个相反方向发光，每束的能量都是 \(L/2\)，这些能量和“同时”都以物体原来静止的参考系为准。作者还规定物体在发光后继续静止。这样，另一位匀速经过的观察者在发光前后看到的物体速度也相同；比较动能时，就能把速度变化这一因素固定住。
text.en: The setup fixes the body’s motion while its stored energy changes. It emits simultaneously in opposite directions, with energy \(L/2\) in each beam; both the energies and simultaneity refer to the frame in which the body was initially at rest. The author stipulates that it stays at rest. An observer moving uniformly past it therefore sees the same body speed before and after emission, keeping speed fixed in the kinetic-energy comparison.

text.zh: 为什么这种无反冲的设定合理？动量是描述运动状态、并且带有方向的物理量；在没有外界推动的过程中，物体与发出光的总动量应当守恒。这里补充使用光的动量关系 \(p=E/c\)：\(p\) 是光的动量大小，\(E\) 是光能，\(c\) 是光速。沿两束光所在直线规定一个正方向，两束光的带符号动量相加便是 \[\frac{L}{2c}-\frac{L}{2c}=0.\] 物体因此无需通过反向运动补上一个净动量。
text.en: Why is this no-recoil setup reasonable? Momentum describes motion and has a direction; without an external push, the total momentum of the body and emitted light is conserved. The supplementary light-momentum relation is \(p=E/c\), where \(p\) is momentum magnitude, \(E\) is light energy, and \(c\) is the speed of light. Choose a positive direction along the line of the beams. Their signed momenta add to \[\frac{L}{2c}-\frac{L}{2c}=0.\] There is consequently no net emitted momentum for the body to balance by recoiling.

text.zh: 原短文直接采用这个对称、静止的设定；上面的动量说明来自后来教学论证所用的物理输入。若只向一侧发光，光的动量就没有另一束来抵消，反冲会改变物体速度，发光前后“同一个速度”的比较也要随之重写。
text.en: The original note adopts the symmetric, stationary setup directly. The momentum explanation above uses inputs made explicit in a later teaching argument. With emission to only one side, no second beam cancels the light’s momentum: recoil changes the body’s speed, and the same-speed comparison must be revised.

title.zh: 为什么两位观察者都能用能量守恒？
title.en: Why both observers can use energy conservation

summary.zh: 能量守恒在两个匀速相对运动的参考系中都成立；每一系分别计算物体与两束光的能量，并让发光前后的总额相等。
summary.en: Energy conservation holds in both uniformly moving frames. Each observer separately accounts for the body and both beams, equating the total energy before and after emission.

reasoning.zh: 取物体与发出的两束光为记账边界。若有外部做功或漏记能量流，原平衡方程须相应补项。
reasoning.en: Account for the body and both emitted beams. External work or omitted energy flux requires extra balance terms.

why.zh: 能量守恒是作者采用的物理前提，相对性原理要求两位惯性观察者使用同一条定律；他们测得的能量数值可以不同。
why.en: Energy conservation is a physical premise of the argument. Relativity requires the same law for both inertial observers, even though their measured energies can differ.

text.zh: 发光前，所考虑的能量都在物体中；发光后，一部分仍在物体中，一部分随两束光离开。把“物体加两束光”作为同一个完整的能量账目，且没有其他外界做功或能量流入流出，能量守恒就要求：发光前物体的能量，等于发光后物体的能量加上两束光的能量。光离开了物体，但仍被计入这笔总账。
text.en: Before emission, the energy being considered is in the body. Afterward, some remains there and some leaves with the two beams. Account for the body and both beams together, with no other external work or energy transfer. Conservation then equates the body’s initial energy to its final energy plus the energy in the light. The light has left the body but remains part of the total account.

text.zh: 现在换一位相对物体匀速运动的观察者。这样的参考系叫惯性系：它没有因为自身加速而引入额外的惯性效应。相对性原理说，彼此匀速平移的惯性系采用相同形式的物理定律。因此，既然第一位观察者用能量守恒描述这次发光，第二位也应当能用。这是物理原则在此处的应用；短文把它作为推导的起点。
text.en: Now consider an observer moving uniformly relative to the body. This is an inertial frame, with no extra inertial effects introduced by acceleration of the frame itself. The relativity principle says that inertial frames in uniform relative translation use physical laws of the same form. If the first observer uses energy conservation for the emission, the second must be able to do so as well. The note takes these physical principles as its starting point.

text.zh: “同一条守恒定律”并不要求两人写下相同的能量数值。你熟悉的动能就会随物体相对观察者的速度而改变；本文引用的光能量变换也说明，同一束光在两系中的能量可以不同。正确做法是让每位观察者先用自己那一系的数值把账配平，再用能量变换关系连接两套方程。
text.en: Using the same conservation law does not require identical numerical energies. Familiar kinetic energy already depends on the object’s speed relative to the observer, and the light-energy transformation used here likewise assigns different energies to the same beam in different frames. Each observer first balances quantities measured in their own frame; the transformation then connects the two balances.

title.zh: 静止系中，物体为什么少掉 \(L\) 的能量？
title.en: Why the body loses \(L\) in its rest frame

summary.zh: 在物体的静止系中，两束光合计带走能量 \(L\)，所以物体自身的能量减少 \(L\)：\(E_0-E_1=L\)。
summary.en: The two beams carry away total energy \(L\) in the body’s rest frame, so its own energy decreases by \(L\): \(E_0-E_1=L\).

reasoning.zh: 能量相加 \(\frac L2+\frac L2=L\)，然后从发光前总能量减去发光后总能量。
reasoning.en: Add \(\frac L2+\frac L2=L\) and equate this to the body’s before-minus-after energy.

why.zh: 守恒方程把“发光前的物体”与“发光后的物体加两束光”相等；两束光各带走 \(L/2\)。
why.en: Conservation equates the initial body energy to the final body energy plus the two beams, each carrying \(L/2\).

text.zh: 在这一式中，观察者始终与物体一起静止。\(E_0\) 是物体发光前的能量，\(E_1\) 是发光后留在物体里的能量；下标 \(0\) 和 \(1\) 只标记先后状态。\(L\) 定义为这位观察者测得的总光能，两束相反方向的光各占 \(L/2\)。物体静止并不意味着 \(E_0\) 或 \(E_1\) 为零，它仍然可以储存内部能量。
text.en: This equation uses an observer at rest with the body throughout. \(E_0\) is the body’s energy before emission and \(E_1\) the energy left in it afterward; subscripts \(0\) and \(1\) mark the two states. \(L\) is the total light energy measured by this observer, divided equally between opposite beams. Being at rest does not make \(E_0\) or \(E_1\) zero: the body can still store internal energy.

text.zh: 把光也计入，发光后的总能量就是 \(E_1+L/2+L/2\)。没有其他能量交换时，守恒给出 \[\begin{aligned}E_0&=E_1+\frac L2+\frac L2\\&=E_1+L,\\E_0-E_1&=L.\end{aligned}\] 最后一行只是从等式两边都减去 \(E_1\)，它把“物体减少多少”直接表示出来。这个 \(L\) 是内部储能的减少量，也是两束光在这一参考系中带走的能量。
text.en: Including the light, the final total is \(E_1+L/2+L/2\). With no other energy transfer, conservation gives \[\begin{aligned}E_0&=E_1+\frac L2+\frac L2\\&=E_1+L,\\E_0-E_1&=L.\end{aligned}\] The last line subtracts \(E_1\) from both sides to express the body’s loss directly. That loss of stored energy is precisely the energy carried by the two beams in this frame.

title.zh: 运动系为什么测到总光能 \(\gamma L\)？
title.en: Why the moving frame measures total light energy \(\gamma L\)

summary.zh: 两束反向光在运动系中的能量变化不一样，但方向造成的增减在总和中抵消，留下总光能 \(\gamma L\)。所以物体在这一系中的能量损失为 \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\)。
summary.en: The opposite beams change energy differently in the moving frame, but their directional contributions cancel in the sum, leaving total light energy \(\gamma L\). The body therefore loses \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\) in this frame.

reasoning.zh: \[\begin{aligned}&\frac L2\gamma(1-\beta\cos\phi)\\&\quad+\frac L2\gamma(1+\beta\cos\phi)\\&=\gamma L\end{aligned}\]。应用能量守恒得\(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\)。
reasoning.en: \[\begin{aligned}&\frac L2\gamma(1-\beta\cos\phi)\\&\quad+\frac L2\gamma(1+\beta\cos\phi)\\&=\gamma L\end{aligned}\]. Conservation gives \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\).

why.zh: 每束光都带有同一个速度因子 \(\gamma\)，而反向传播让另一个含角度的因子一减一加；相加后只剩共同的速度因子。
why.en: Both beams share the speed factor \(\gamma\). Opposite propagation makes their angular contributions equal and opposite, so only the common speed factor remains in the total.

text.zh: 这里需要一个相对论输入：Einstein 在此前论文第 8 节推导了，同一束光换一个匀速运动的观察者后，测得的能量怎样改变。若物体静止系中的光能为 \(l\)，另一系测得的是 \[\begin{aligned}l^*&=l\gamma\left(1-\frac vc\cos\phi\right),\\\gamma&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\] \(c\) 是光速，\(v\) 是两系的相对速度；\(\phi\) 是在物体静止系中，光线与两系相对运动方向的夹角。\(\gamma\) 是这个根式的简称，数值由 \(v/c\) 决定。这个输入来自电磁场能量密度和光所占体积的共同变换。
text.en: This step uses a relativistic result from section 8 of Einstein’s earlier paper: how a different, uniformly moving observer measures the energy of the same beam. If its energy in the body’s rest frame is \(l\), the other frame measures \[\begin{aligned}l^*&=l\gamma\left(1-\frac vc\cos\phi\right),\\\gamma&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\] Here \(c\) is the speed of light and \(v\) the relative frame speed. The angle \(\phi\) is measured in the body’s rest frame between the ray and the direction of relative frame motion. \(\gamma\) abbreviates the square-root expression and depends on \(v/c\). The input result comes from transforming both electromagnetic energy density and the volume occupied by the light.

text.zh: 把这个结果用于两束各有 \(L/2\) 能量的光。\(\cos\phi\) 表示光线方向沿相对运动方向的投影比例；把光线反过来，这个投影就变号。因此，两束光在新系中的能量分别为 \[\begin{aligned}l_+^*&=\frac L2\gamma\left(1-\frac vc\cos\phi\right),\\l_-^*&=\frac L2\gamma\left(1+\frac vc\cos\phi\right).\end{aligned}\] 下标 \(+\) 和 \(-\) 在这里仅用来区分两个相反方向的光束。
text.en: Apply this result to the two beams, each carrying \(L/2\) in the rest frame. The cosine gives the fraction of the ray’s direction projected along the relative motion. Reversing the ray reverses this projection, so the transformed energies are \[\begin{aligned}l_+^*&=\frac L2\gamma\left(1-\frac vc\cos\phi\right),\\l_-^*&=\frac L2\gamma\left(1+\frac vc\cos\phi\right).\end{aligned}\] The subscripts \(+\) and \(-\) simply distinguish the oppositely directed beams.

text.zh: 现在求总光能。先把共同的 \(L\gamma/2\) 提出来，括号里一正一负的角度项恰好抵消：\[\begin{aligned}l_+^*+l_-^*&=\frac{L\gamma}{2}\left[\left(1-\frac vc\cos\phi\right)\right.\\&\qquad\left.+\left(1+\frac vc\cos\phi\right)\right]\\&=\frac{L\gamma}{2}\times2=\gamma L.\end{aligned}\] 可见，总量与光沿哪个角度发出无关，但仍随两位观察者的相对速度改变。
text.en: To find the total, factor out the common \(L\gamma/2\). The opposite angular terms cancel inside the brackets: \[\begin{aligned}l_+^*+l_-^*&=\frac{L\gamma}{2}\left[\left(1-\frac vc\cos\phi\right)\right.\\&\qquad\left.+\left(1+\frac vc\cos\phi\right)\right]\\&=\frac{L\gamma}{2}\times2=\gamma L.\end{aligned}\] The total is therefore independent of the emission angle, while still depending on the observers’ relative speed.

text.zh: 最后把这笔光能放回物体的能量账目。\(H_0\)、\(H_1\) 分别是运动系中物体发光前后的能量。没有其他能量交换时，\(H_0=H_1+\gamma L\)，因而 \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\)。这位观察者看到光带走多少能量，物体就减少多少；这里所有量都在同一运动系中计算。
text.en: Finally insert the light energy into the body’s energy balance. \(H_0\) and \(H_1\) denote its moving-frame energies before and after emission. With no other energy transfer, \(H_0=H_1+\gamma L\), giving \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\). The body loses exactly the energy this observer assigns to the emitted light, with every term evaluated in the same moving frame.

title.zh: 为什么要把两系的能量方程相减？
title.en: Why subtract the two energy balances?

summary.zh: 相减后，静止系与运动系对“物体损失多少能量”的差别被单独提取出来：它等于 \(L(\gamma-1)\)，也等于发光前后两次 \(H-E\) 的差。
summary.en: Subtraction isolates how much the frames differ about the body’s energy loss. It is \(L(\gamma-1)\), equal to the difference between the before-and-after values of \(H-E\).

reasoning.en: Original frame: \(E_0-E_1=L\).

reasoning.zh: 运动系：\(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\)。
reasoning.en: Moving frame: \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\).

reasoning.zh: 两式相减即得 \[\begin{aligned}(H_0-E_0)&-(H_1-E_1)\\&=L(\gamma-1)\end{aligned}\]。
reasoning.en: Subtract to get \[\begin{aligned}(H_0-E_0)&-(H_1-E_1)\\&=L(\gamma-1)\end{aligned}\].

limits.zh: 能量守恒在此是原文调用的物理原则；物体加辐射的系统边界应包括过程中的全部能量交换。
limits.en: Energy conservation is invoked as a physical principle. The body-plus-radiation boundary must include all energy exchanges in the process.

why.zh: 静止系记下储能损失 \(L\)，运动系记下 \(\gamma L\)。扣掉两者共有的这一笔 \(L\)，就能研究与整体运动有关的额外变化。
why.en: The rest frame records a stored-energy loss \(L\), while the moving frame records \(\gamma L\). Removing the common \(L\) isolates the additional change associated with overall motion.

text.zh: 同一个物体对称发光，在它的静止系中，两束光总共带走 \(L\)；在相对速度为 \(v\) 的另一系中，光能变换使总量成为 \(\gamma L\)，其中 \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\)，\(c\) 是光速。物体发光前后在两系中的能量分别用 \(E_0,E_1\) 和 \(H_0,H_1\) 表示。能量守恒便给出 \(E_0-E_1=L\) 与 \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\)。
text.en: A body emits symmetrically. The beams carry total energy \(L\) in its rest frame and, by the light-energy transformation, \(\gamma L\) in another frame moving at relative speed \(v\). Here \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\) and \(c\) is the speed of light. Write the body’s before-and-after energies as \(E_0,E_1\) in the rest frame and \(H_0,H_1\) in the moving frame. Conservation gives \(E_0-E_1=L\) and \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\).

text.zh: 我们想知道，物体的整体运动给能量损失增加了什么。为此，从运动系的损失中减去静止系的损失：\[\begin{aligned}(H_0-H_1)-(E_0-E_1)&=\gamma L-L\\&=L(\gamma-1).\end{aligned}\] 这样，右边只剩两种观察方式之间的差额；它的来源是同一对光束在两系中具有不同的总能量。
text.en: The question is what overall motion adds to the energy loss. Subtract the rest-frame loss from the moving-frame loss: \[\begin{aligned}(H_0-H_1)-(E_0-E_1)&=\gamma L-L\\&=L(\gamma-1).\end{aligned}\] The right-hand side now contains only the difference between the two accounts, originating in the different total energies assigned to the same pair of beams.

text.zh: 左边还可以按“发光前”和“发光后”重新分组。展开减号时要注意，减去 \(E_0-E_1\) 会产生 \(-E_0+E_1\)，所以 \[\begin{aligned}&H_0-H_1-E_0+E_1\\&=(H_0-E_0)-(H_1-E_1).\end{aligned}\] 第一组 \(H_0-E_0\) 比较发光前同一状态的两系能量；第二组 \(H_1-E_1\) 对发光后做同样比较。因此这条方程告诉我们：发光让“运动系能量减静止系能量”减少了 \(L(\gamma-1)\)。
text.en: Regroup the left side by before and after emission. Subtracting \(E_0-E_1\) gives \(-E_0+E_1\), so \[\begin{aligned}&H_0-H_1-E_0+E_1\\&=(H_0-E_0)-(H_1-E_1).\end{aligned}\] The first group compares the two frame energies for the initial state; the second does the same for the final state. Emission has therefore reduced the quantity “moving-frame energy minus rest-frame energy” by \(L(\gamma-1)\).

text.zh: 重新分组的物理用意在于：对固定的内部状态，\(H-E\) 正是作者用来联系整体运动动能的量。相减这一步本身只用了能量守恒和代数；要把结果称作动能减少量，还需要说明 \(H-E\) 与动能之间的关系，以及两次比较使用相同能量零点的条件。
text.en: This grouping matters because \(H-E\), for a fixed internal state, is the quantity Einstein connects to the energy of overall motion. The subtraction itself uses conservation and algebra. Identifying its result as a kinetic-energy loss additionally requires the relation between \(H-E\) and kinetic energy, with consistent energy zeros in both state comparisons.

title.zh: 把 \(H-E\) 叫作动能，需要什么条件？
title.en: When does \(H-E\) describe kinetic energy?

summary.zh: 比较同一个完整物体、同一内部状态在静止和整体运动时的能量，可以把差值解释为平移动能 \(K\)，再加上固定的能量零点差 \(C\)。这既需要一致的记数约定，也需要完整物体的物理条件。
summary.en: For the same complete body in the same internal state, the difference between its moving and rest energies can be identified with translational kinetic energy \(K\), plus a fixed energy-zero offset \(C\). This requires both consistent conventions and suitable physical conditions for the whole body.

reasoning.zh: 为物体的每一个内部状态，比较它在静止系和运动系的总能量。
reasoning.en: For each internal state, compare the body’s rest-frame and moving-frame total energies.

reasoning.zh: 采用 \(H_0-E_0=K_0+C\) 和 \(H_1-E_1=K_1+C\) 的共同零点约定。
reasoning.en: Use \(H_0-E_0=K_0+C\) and \(H_1-E_1=K_1+C\) with a common offset.

reasoning.zh: 若误令 \(C_{0}\) 与 \(C_{1}\) 独立变化，右边会多出 \(C_0-C_1\)，无法直接得到原文的动能差。
reasoning.en: If \(C_{0}\) and \(C_{1}\) vary independently, an additional \(C_0-C_1\) remains and the stated kinetic-energy difference does not follow.

limits.zh: 共同常数的抵消是清楚的代数步骤；对受外力、应力遗漏或内运动显著的扩展系统，\(H-E\) 的物理解读还须补充条件。
limits.en: Cancellation of a common constant is elementary; extended systems with external forces, omitted stresses, or substantial internal motions require additional conditions for the physical interpretation of \(H-E\).

label.zh: 后续研究对论证范围有争论
label.en: Later debate about the argument’s scope

detail.zh: Ohanian认为一般扩展物体的内运动与应力处理需要补充。这是已核读论文的批评；其提及的Stachel–Torretti辩护原文尚未取得，争论双方的论证读取尚不对称。
detail.en: Ohanian calls for additional treatment of internal motion and stresses. This is his inspected critique; the Stachel–Torretti defense he cites remains unavailable, leaving asymmetric access to the debate.

why.zh: 两系比较要只改变整体运动，并完整计入物体的能量与维持它的作用；在此基础上，\(H-E-K\) 才能只是与状态无关的零点差。
why.en: The frame comparison must change only overall motion while accounting for all the body’s energy and supporting interactions. Only then can the residual \(H-E-K\) be solely a state-independent energy-zero offset.

text.zh: 这里有两种比较，先把它们分开。第一种固定物体的内部状态，让一位观察者与它一起静止、另一位相对它匀速运动；两人测得的物体能量分别记作 \(E\) 和 \(H\)。第二种才是比较发光前与发光后，此时物体的内部储能变了。原文先对每一个状态做第一种比较，再拿两个状态的结果相减。
text.en: Two comparisons are involved. First, hold the body’s internal state fixed and let one observer be at rest with it while another moves uniformly relative to it. Their measured body energies are \(E\) and \(H\). The second comparison is between before and after emission, when the stored internal energy has changed. The paper first compares frames for each state, then subtracts the results for the two states.

text.zh: 物体静止时仍可有热等内部能量，所以 \(E\) 也要保留。这里“平移动能” \(K\) 指内部状态相同的整个物体，因整体运动而多出的能量；“平移”是为了区分整体运动与物体内部各部分的运动。若整个物体的能量确实能按这种方式分开，运动时的总能量与静止时的总能量之差就给出 \(K\)。对由许多成分组成的物体，这是一项需要物理依据的识别。
text.en: A stationary body can still contain internal energy, such as thermal energy, so \(E\) must be retained. Here translational kinetic energy \(K\) means the extra energy associated with motion of the whole body while its internal state is kept the same. “Translational” distinguishes overall motion from motion of its internal parts. If the complete body’s energy admits this separation, moving energy minus rest energy gives \(K\). For a body made of many parts, that identification needs a physical basis.

text.zh: 能量的数值还涉及零点约定。熟悉的重力势能也要先选零点，这提醒我们：给所有能量数值统一加一个常数，会改变读数，却不改变用同一零点计算的能量变化。原文用 \(C\) 收集 \(H\) 与 \(E\) 两套记数约定的差，于是写成 \[H-E=K+C.\] \(C\) 记录数值从哪里开始计数；发光释放的能量则属于物体状态的实际变化。
text.en: Numerical energy values also involve a choice of zero. Familiar gravitational potential energy requires such a choice: adding one constant to every value changes the readings but leaves changes measured with that same zero unchanged. The paper collects the offset between the \(H\) and \(E\) conventions in \(C\), writing \[H-E=K+C.\] The constant records the numerical origin; the emitted energy belongs to the actual change in the body’s state.

text.zh: 对发光前后的两个状态，作者分别写 \(H_0-E_0=K_0+C\) 和 \(H_1-E_1=K_1+C\)。同一个 \(C\) 的条件是：两次沿用相同的能量定义、同一套固定零点，以及一致的物体边界；同时，\(H-E-K\) 的剩余部分确实只有零点差。如果漏记的物理贡献随内部状态改变，就必须把它计入模型，选择零点本身不能让它消失。
text.en: For the states before and after emission, Einstein writes \(H_0-E_0=K_0+C\) and \(H_1-E_1=K_1+C\). A common \(C\) requires the same energy definitions, fixed zeros, and consistent body boundaries in both comparisons, with the residual \(H-E-K\) consisting solely of that offset. An omitted physical contribution that changes with the internal state must be accounted for in the model; choosing energy zeros cannot remove it.

heading.en: What belongs to the whole body?

text.zh: 这正是完整物体的条件发挥作用之处。内部的场，以及维持物体平衡的拉力、压力等“应力”，都要和物质一起计入。Laue 后来处理了与外界无相互作用、在自身静止系中处于静态平衡的完整系统，证明其总能量与动量具有相应的整体变换规律，从而支持这样的动能解释。该结果给出了具体的成立条件；一般具有内部运动或外界支撑的物体，还需要相应的整体分析。
text.en: This is where completeness of the body matters. Internal fields and the tensile or compressive forces that maintain equilibrium—called stresses—must be included along with the matter. Laue later treated complete systems with no external interaction and static equilibrium in their rest frame. Their total energy and momentum obey the corresponding overall transformation laws, supporting this kinetic-energy interpretation. That result supplies definite sufficient conditions; bodies with general internal motion or external support need the corresponding whole-system analysis.

title.zh: 为什么发光前后可以消去同一个 \(C\)？
title.en: Why the same \(C\) can cancel before and after emission

summary.zh: 如果 \(C\) 只记录两套固定能量零点的差，它就与物体发光前后的状态无关，两式相减时会消去。这个条件先成立，才能把两次 \(H-E\) 的差识别为动能差。
summary.en: If \(C\) records only the difference between fixed energy zeros, it is independent of the body’s before-and-after states and cancels on subtraction. That condition is needed to identify the change in \(H-E\) with the kinetic-energy change.

reasoning.zh: 为物体的每一个内部状态，比较它在静止系和运动系的总能量。
reasoning.en: For each internal state, compare the body’s rest-frame and moving-frame total energies.

reasoning.zh: 采用 \(H_0-E_0=K_0+C\) 和 \(H_1-E_1=K_1+C\) 的共同零点约定。
reasoning.en: Use \(H_0-E_0=K_0+C\) and \(H_1-E_1=K_1+C\) with a common offset.

reasoning.zh: 若误令 \(C_{0}\) 与 \(C_{1}\) 独立变化，右边会多出 \(C_0-C_1\)，无法直接得到原文的动能差。
reasoning.en: If \(C_{0}\) and \(C_{1}\) vary independently, an additional \(C_0-C_1\) remains and the stated kinetic-energy difference does not follow.

limits.zh: 共同常数的抵消是清楚的代数步骤；对受外力、应力遗漏或内运动显著的扩展系统，\(H-E\) 的物理解读还须补充条件。
limits.en: Cancellation of a common constant is elementary; extended systems with external forces, omitted stresses, or substantial internal motions require additional conditions for the physical interpretation of \(H-E\).

why.zh: 统一改变能量的数值起点只会加上同一个常数；只有两次比较共用这个起点，相减才留下纯粹的物理变化。
why.en: A uniform change of energy origin adds the same constant to every value. Subtraction isolates the physical change when both state comparisons use that shared origin.

text.zh: 这里的 \(E\) 是物体静止系中的能量，\(H\) 是另一匀速运动系中的能量，\(K\) 是物体在后一系中的整体平移动能。原文采用 \(H-E=K+C\)：在物体的能量已被完整计入、这项动能解释成立时，\(C\) 只记录两套能量数值零点的差。现在要说明的，是为什么换到发光后的状态仍可使用同一个 \(C\)。
text.en: Here \(E\) is the body’s rest-frame energy, \(H\) its energy in another uniformly moving frame, and \(K\) its overall translational kinetic energy in that latter frame. The paper uses \(H-E=K+C\). Once the body is fully accounted for and this kinetic-energy identification holds, \(C\) records only the difference between numerical energy zeros. The question is why that same \(C\) still applies after emission.

text.zh: 可以直接看固定零点怎样作用。把 \(E\) 的每个数值都加上常数 \(a\)，把 \(H\) 的每个数值都加上常数 \(b\)，两系能量差就统一多出 \(b-a\)：\[(H+b)-(E+a)=(H-E)+(b-a).\] \(a\)、\(b\) 在这里是以能量为单位的固定加数。它们对发光前和发光后都一样，所以这种改换零点只会统一调整 \(C\)，不会改变它在两个状态之间的差。
text.en: The effect of fixed zeros is explicit. Add a constant \(a\) to every \(E\) value and a constant \(b\) to every \(H\) value. Every frame-energy difference then increases by \(b-a\): \[(H+b)-(E+a)=(H-E)+(b-a).\] The constants \(a\) and \(b\) have units of energy. Because the same additions apply before and after emission, this change of zeros shifts \(C\) uniformly rather than giving it a difference between the two states.

text.zh: 下标 \(0\) 表示发光前，\(1\) 表示发光后。内部储能确实发生了变化，因而 \(E_0\) 与 \(E_1\)、\(H_0\) 与 \(H_1\) 可以不同；记数的零点却保持不动。于是 \[\begin{aligned}&(H_0-E_0)-(H_1-E_1)\\&=(K_0+C)-(K_1+C)\\&=K_0-K_1.\end{aligned}\] 这说明能消去的是同一套固定约定，不是物体实际失去的能量。
text.en: Subscript \(0\) denotes before emission and \(1\) afterward. Stored energy really changes, so \(E_0\) and \(E_1\), and likewise \(H_0\) and \(H_1\), can differ while their numerical zeros stay fixed. Thus \[\begin{aligned}&(H_0-E_0)-(H_1-E_1)\\&=(K_0+C)-(K_1+C)\\&=K_0-K_1.\end{aligned}\] The cancellation removes the shared fixed convention, leaving the physical energy change in the comparison.

text.zh: 若给两个状态分别写 \(C_0\) 与 \(C_1\)，同样的代数就留下 \(K_0-K_1+C_0-C_1\)。假如差别来自重新选了数值零点，应先统一约定；假如差别来自漏记了随状态变化的场能或支撑作用，则须补全物理系统。原文明确断言 \(C\) 在发光时不变；它的可用条件是固定零点加上成立的整体动能解释。
text.en: Writing separate offsets \(C_0\) and \(C_1\) instead leaves \(K_0-K_1+C_0-C_1\). A discrepancy caused by changing numerical zeros is resolved by using consistent conventions. One caused by omitted field energy or supporting interactions that vary with state requires completing the physical system. The paper explicitly asserts that \(C\) is unchanged during emission; using that assertion requires fixed zeros together with a valid whole-body kinetic-energy interpretation.

title.zh: 光的能量差怎样变成物体的动能差？
title.en: How the light-energy difference determines the body’s kinetic-energy loss

summary.zh: 在对称发光、两系能量守恒和共同零点的动能解释下，物体的动能减少量为 \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\)。式中保留了完整的速度因子，因此这一步还没有作低速近似。
summary.en: With symmetric emission, conservation in both frames, and the kinetic-energy interpretation using a common offset, the body loses \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\) in kinetic energy. The full speed factor is retained, with no low-speed approximation at this step.

reasoning.zh: 将 t-additive-constant 代入 t-energy-balance，共同 \(C\) 消去。
reasoning.en: Insert t-additive-constant into t-energy-balance; the common \(C\) cancels.

reasoning.zh: 得到 \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L\left[(1-v^2/c^2)^{-1/2}-1\right]\end{aligned}\]。
reasoning.en: Obtain \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L\left[(1-v^2/c^2)^{-1/2}-1\right]\end{aligned}\].

reasoning.zh: \(L>0\) 且 \(v\ne0\) 时 \(\gamma>1\)，所以 \(K_0>K_1\)；\(v=0\) 时两者均无这项平移动能差。
reasoning.en: For \(L>0\) and \(v\ne0\), \(\gamma>1\) and \(K_0>K_1\); at \(v=0\) this translational kinetic-energy difference vanishes.

limits.zh: 精确的是此动能差在给定假设下的表达式。其形式不自动完成所有扩展物体的动能理论。
limits.en: The difference is exact under the stated assumptions; its form alone does not supply a complete kinetic-energy theory for every extended body.

why.zh: 运动系记下的光能比静止系多 \(L(\gamma-1)\)；两系守恒要求物体也多损失这一份能量，而一致的 \(H-E=K+C\) 关系把它识别为动能减少量。
why.en: The moving frame assigns \(L(\gamma-1)\) more energy to the light than the rest frame. Conservation requires the corresponding extra body-energy loss, which a consistent \(H-E=K+C\) identification makes into a kinetic-energy loss.

text.zh: 设物体同时向相反方向各发出 \(L/2\) 的光能，并在它原来的静止系中继续静止。另一位观察者与它的相对速度为 \(v\)。从此前论文引入的光能量变换给出：两束光在静止系合计为 \(L\)，在运动系合计为 \(\gamma L\)，其中 \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\)，\(c\) 是光速。角度有关的两项因光线反向而抵消。
text.en: Let a body emit \(L/2\) in each of two opposite directions, simultaneously in its original rest frame, and remain at rest there. Another observer has relative speed \(v\). The light-energy transformation imported from the earlier paper gives total beam energy \(L\) in the rest frame and \(\gamma L\) in the moving frame, where \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\) and \(c\) is the speed of light. The angular terms cancel because the beams are opposite.

text.zh: 用 \(E_0,E_1\) 表示静止系中物体发光前后的能量，\(H_0,H_1\) 表示运动系中相应的能量。光带走多少，物体就失去多少，所以 \(E_0-E_1=L\)、\(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\)。把第一式从第二式减去，并把发光前、后的项分别放在一起：\[\begin{aligned}(H_0-E_0)&-(H_1-E_1)\\&=\gamma L-L=L(\gamma-1).\end{aligned}\] 这一步先确定了两种能量账目的差额如何改变。
text.en: Write the body’s rest-frame energies before and after emission as \(E_0,E_1\), and its corresponding moving-frame energies as \(H_0,H_1\). The body loses what the light carries away, giving \(E_0-E_1=L\) and \(H_0-H_1=\gamma L\). Subtract the first equation from the second and regroup by before and after: \[\begin{aligned}(H_0-E_0)&-(H_1-E_1)\\&=\gamma L-L=L(\gamma-1).\end{aligned}\] This first establishes how the difference between the two energy accounts changes.

text.zh: 要读出动能，就采用作者对每一状态的识别：\(H-E=K+C\)。\(K\) 是物体整体运动的动能，\(C\) 是两套固定能量零点的差。物体边界和动能解释保持一致、前后沿用同一个 \(C\) 时，左边化为 \((K_0+C)-(K_1+C)=K_0-K_1\)，因此 \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L(\gamma-1)\\&=L\left[\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}-1\right].\end{aligned}\] 物体前后速度相同，式子比较的是储能改变前后、同一速度下的动能。
text.en: To identify kinetic energy, use the paper’s relation for each state: \(H-E=K+C\). Here \(K\) is the energy of overall motion and \(C\) the offset between fixed energy zeros. With consistent body boundaries and kinetic-energy interpretation, and the same \(C\) in both states, the left side becomes \((K_0+C)-(K_1+C)=K_0-K_1\). Hence \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L(\gamma-1)\\&=L\left[\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}-1\right].\end{aligned}\] The body has the same speed in both states, so the equation compares kinetic energies at that speed before and after its stored energy changes.

text.zh: 这里的“精确”指在这些设定和物理识别之内，计算一直保留整个根式，对 \(|v|<c\) 没有舍去任何速度项。它直接确定了两个状态的动能之差；若要给一般复杂物体写出每一个状态的完整动能，还要处理其内部能量、应力及整体边界。
text.en: “Exact” here means that, within these conditions and physical identifications, the full square-root expression has been retained for \(|v|<c\), without dropping any speed terms. It directly determines the kinetic-energy difference between two states. A complete kinetic-energy formula for a general composite body also requires its internal energy, stresses, and system boundaries to be treated.

title.zh: 速度没变，动能为什么反而减少？
title.en: Why kinetic energy decreases at unchanged speed

summary.zh: 对运动观察者而言，这个对称发光的物体速度保持不变，动能却减少。只要发出的能量 \(L>0\)、相对速度满足 \(0<|v|<c\)，减少量 \(L(\gamma-1)\) 就为正。
summary.en: The moving observer sees unchanged body speed but reduced kinetic energy after symmetric emission. For emitted energy \(L>0\) and relative speed \(0<|v|<c\), the loss \(L(\gamma-1)\) is positive.

reasoning.zh: 将 t-additive-constant 代入 t-energy-balance，共同 \(C\) 消去。
reasoning.en: Insert t-additive-constant into t-energy-balance; the common \(C\) cancels.

reasoning.zh: 得到 \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L\left[(1-v^2/c^2)^{-1/2}-1\right]\end{aligned}\]。
reasoning.en: Obtain \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L\left[(1-v^2/c^2)^{-1/2}-1\right]\end{aligned}\].

reasoning.zh: \(L>0\) 且 \(v\ne0\) 时 \(\gamma>1\)，所以 \(K_0>K_1\)；\(v=0\) 时两者均无这项平移动能差。
reasoning.en: For \(L>0\) and \(v\ne0\), \(\gamma>1\) and \(K_0>K_1\); at \(v=0\) this translational kinetic-energy difference vanishes.

limits.zh: 精确的是此动能差在给定假设下的表达式。其形式不自动完成所有扩展物体的动能理论。
limits.en: The difference is exact under the stated assumptions; its form alone does not supply a complete kinetic-energy theory for every extended body.

why.zh: 对称发光固定住物体的速度；两系能量守恒与动能解释却要求一个正的动能差，所以变化来自发光后物体的状态。
why.en: Symmetric emission fixes the speed, while conservation in both frames and the kinetic-energy identification require a positive loss. The change therefore comes from the body’s state after emission.

text.zh: 先把速度为什么相同说清楚。物体在自己的静止系中，同时向两个相反方向发出等能量的光，按设定没有反冲。因此另一位与它匀速相对运动的观察者，在发光前后看到的相对速度都是 \(v\)。用 \(K_0\)、\(K_1\) 表示这位观察者测得的前后动能，\(L\) 表示物体静止系中的总发光能量。
text.en: The speed is fixed by the setup. In its rest frame the body emits equal energies simultaneously in opposite directions, with no recoil. An observer in uniform relative motion therefore sees the same relative speed \(v\) before and after. Write the kinetic energies measured by this observer as \(K_0\) and \(K_1\), and the total emitted energy in the body’s rest frame as \(L\).

text.zh: 两系分别应用能量守恒，再用共同能量零点下的动能解释，可以得到 \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\)，其中 \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\)，\(c\) 是光速。这里判断正负只需代数：当 \(0<|v|<c\) 时，\(1-v^2/c^2\) 介于 \(0\) 和 \(1\) 之间，其平方根也如此，倒数 \(\gamma\) 就大于 \(1\)。于是 \(L>0\) 给出 \(K_0-K_1>0\)，即发光后的 \(K_1\) 更小。
text.en: Conservation in both frames, together with the kinetic-energy interpretation using a common energy offset, gives \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\), where \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\) and \(c\) is the speed of light. The sign follows from algebra: for \(0<|v|<c\), both \(1-v^2/c^2\) and its square root lie between \(0\) and \(1\), so the reciprocal \(\gamma\) exceeds \(1\). With \(L>0\), this makes \(K_0-K_1>0\): the final kinetic energy is smaller.

text.zh: 这并不与熟悉的动能概念冲突。低速时 \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\)，动能除了取决于速度，也取决于惯性质量 \(m\)。在相同速度下出现不同动能，正好给了我们用低速系数识别质量变化的办法。若观察者与物体一起静止，则 \(v=0\)、\(\gamma=1\)，两次整体平移动能都为零；物体仍然失去了内部能量 \(L\)。这两种观察结果属于各自的参考系。
text.en: This fits the familiar structure of kinetic energy. At low speed, \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\) depends on inertial mass \(m\) as well as speed. Different kinetic energies at the same speed therefore provide a way to identify a mass change through the low-speed coefficient. For an observer at rest with the body, \(v=0\) and \(\gamma=1\); both overall translational kinetic energies are zero, while the body still loses internal energy \(L\). Each statement refers to its own frame.

title.zh: “与物体性质无关”究竟说的是哪一项？
title.en: What is independent of the body’s properties?

summary.zh: 在同样的对称发光条件下，给定总光能 \(L\) 和观察速度 \(v\)，动能减少量就已确定；材料、形状或初始质量没有单独出现在这项差值的公式中。
summary.en: For the same symmetric-emission conditions, the emitted energy \(L\) and observation speed \(v\) determine the kinetic-energy loss. Material, shape, and initial mass do not appear separately in the formula for that difference.

reasoning.zh: 检查 \(L(\gamma-1)\) 的参数：没有形状、材料、化学组成或初始质量。
reasoning.en: Inspect the parameters in \(L(\gamma-1)\): no shape, material, chemical composition, or initial mass appears.

reasoning.zh: 给 \(K_{0}\) 与 \(K_{1}\) 同时加上同一个依赖 \(v\) 的函数并不改变差值，因此差值的普适形式本身不足以确定二者各自的形式。
reasoning.en: Adding the same function of \(v\) to \(K_{0}\) and \(K_{1}\) leaves their difference unchanged; a universal difference alone does not determine each function.

limits.zh: 结论继承无反冲发射、能量守恒和 \(H-E\) 的动能解释等条件。对于一般扩展系统，须继续检查完整系统和应力条件。
limits.en: The conclusion inherits no-recoil emission, energy conservation, and the kinetic interpretation of \(H-E\). General extended systems still require complete-system and stress conditions.

why.zh: 推导得到的是 \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\)，右边只含 \(L\)、\(v\) 和光速 \(c\)。一个确定的差值仍可以对应不同的发光前后动能。
why.en: The result is \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\), whose right side contains only \(L\), \(v\), and the speed of light \(c\). A fixed difference can still correspond to different initial and final kinetic energies.

text.zh: 要理解“无关”，先固定比较的问题。物体在自身静止系中沿相反方向发出相等的光能，总量为 \(L\)，并保持无反冲。另一位观察者在发光前后都看到相同的物体速度 \(v\)。我们问的是这次发光让动能减少多少，分别用 \(K_0\)、\(K_1\) 表示前后动能。
text.en: To understand “independent,” first fix what is being compared. A body emits equal light energies in opposite directions in its rest frame, totaling \(L\), with no recoil. Another observer sees the same body speed \(v\) before and after. The question is how much kinetic energy the emission removes, with \(K_0\) and \(K_1\) denoting the two kinetic energies.

text.zh: 光能变换使两系记录的总辐射能量分别为 \(L\) 和 \(\gamma L\)。把两系守恒方程相减，并采用一致的整体动能解释与能量零点，便得到 \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L(\gamma-1),\\\gamma&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\] 右边的 \(\gamma\) 只由速度相对光速 \(c\) 的比例决定。只要 \(L\)、\(v\) 一样，公式给出的动能减少量就一样；这就是原句的直接依据。
text.en: The light-energy transformation assigns total radiation energies \(L\) and \(\gamma L\) in the two frames. Subtracting the conservation balances and using a consistent whole-body kinetic-energy interpretation and energy zeros gives \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L(\gamma-1),\\\gamma&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\] The factor \(\gamma\) depends only on speed relative to the light speed \(c\). Identical \(L\) and \(v\) therefore give an identical kinetic-energy loss. This is the direct basis of the sentence.

text.zh: 但差值没有告诉我们 \(K_0\) 与 \(K_1\) 各自多大。数学上，假设给两者同时加上同一个随速度变化的量 \(g(v)\)，其中 \(g\) 只是任意函数的名称，则 \[(K_0+g(v))-(K_1+g(v))=K_0-K_1.\] 这展示了差值方程留下的自由度：它可以固定“减少多少”，却不能单凭自身确定每个状态的全部动能随速度怎样变化。
text.en: The difference does not specify the separate sizes of \(K_0\) and \(K_1\). Algebraically, add the same speed-dependent quantity \(g(v)\) to both, with \(g\) simply naming an arbitrary function. Then \[(K_0+g(v))-(K_1+g(v))=K_0-K_1.\] This shows the freedom left by a difference equation: it can fix how much is lost without by itself fixing the complete speed dependence in each state.

text.zh: 这里的普遍性仍沿用推导的条件：对称无反冲的发射、完整的能量守恒账目，以及成立的整体动能解释。对于包含许多成分的物体，场与维持平衡的压力、拉力等应力也属于整体分析的一部分。Laue 的后续结果为与外界无相互作用的完整静态系统提供了相应依据。
text.en: This universality retains the conditions of the derivation: symmetric emission without recoil, complete energy accounting, and a valid whole-body kinetic-energy interpretation. For a composite body, fields and supporting stresses such as pressure and tension also belong to that analysis. Laue’s later result supplies the corresponding basis for complete static systems without external interaction.

title.zh: 为什么作者在这里提到电子的动能？
title.en: Why the note compares its result with electron kinetic energy

summary.zh: 电子动能与这里的动能减少量具有相同的速度因子 \(\gamma-1\)：前者是 \(mc^2(\gamma-1)\)，后者是 \(L(\gamma-1)\)。这个对应把注意力引向能量 \(L\) 与质量系数之间的关系。
summary.en: The electron’s kinetic energy and the present kinetic-energy loss share the speed factor \(\gamma-1\): they are \(mc^2(\gamma-1)\) and \(L(\gamma-1)\), respectively. This correspondence directs attention to the relation between emitted energy \(L\) and a mass coefficient.

reasoning.zh: 瞬时静止时取 \(ma=qE\)，并用坐标与场变换得到纵向 \(qE=m\gamma^3\frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}t}\)。
reasoning.en: Use \(ma=qE\) at instantaneous rest and transform coordinates and fields to obtain longitudinal \(qE=m\gamma^3\frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}t}\).

reasoning.zh: \[\begin{aligned}K&=\int qE\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=m\int_0^v\gamma^3u\,\mathrm{d}u\end{aligned}\]。
reasoning.en: \[\begin{aligned}K&=\int qE\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=m\int_0^v\gamma^3u\,\mathrm{d}u\end{aligned}\].

reasoning.zh: 因为 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}\gamma}{\mathrm{d}u}=\frac{\gamma^3u}{c^2}\)，积分为 \(mc^2[\gamma(v)-1]\)。
reasoning.en: Since \(\frac{\mathrm{d}\gamma}{\mathrm{d}u}=\frac{\gamma^3u}{c^2}\), the integral is \(mc^2[\gamma(v)-1]\).

limits.zh: 原文对象先是慢加速的带电质点；再以附加任意小电荷的论述推广到可称量质点。此段没有展开任意扩展物体的内部应力积分。
limits.en: The initial object is a slowly accelerated charged point particle, extended to ponderable points by adding arbitrarily small charge. This section does not evaluate all internal stresses of arbitrary extended bodies.

why.zh: 此前论文第 10 节从带电质点的运动方程和电场做功求出了这个速度因子；把它与对称发光得到的差值放在一起，能看清相同的速度依赖和不同的系数。
why.en: Section 10 of the earlier paper derives this speed factor from a charged particle’s equation of motion and electric-field work. Comparing it with the symmetric-emission difference reveals the shared speed dependence and the differing coefficients.

text.zh: 这一引用的作用，是把一个由光的能量守恒得到的式子，接到已经从力和做功算出的动能上。这里需要的旧结果来自 Einstein 此前论文第 10 节：把电子当作带电质点，用外电场沿运动方向缓慢加速，使辐射损失可以忽略。在某一瞬间选一位与电子同速的观察者，电子对他就暂时静止，这叫“瞬时静止系”。惯性质量 \(m\) 由该系中的低速力学确定；外场所做的功用于增加动能。
text.en: The citation connects an expression obtained from light-energy conservation to kinetic energy already calculated from force and work. The needed result comes from section 10 of Einstein’s earlier paper. It treats the electron as a charged point particle, accelerated along its motion by an electric field sufficiently gradually that radiation loss can be neglected. Choose an observer momentarily matching the electron’s velocity: the electron is at rest relative to that observer at that instant, giving an “instantaneous rest frame.” Low-speed mechanics in that frame fixes its inertial mass \(m\), and field work increases kinetic energy.

text.zh: 这个计算的相对论输入是纵向运动方程 \[\begin{aligned}F&=m\gamma(u)^3\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}t},\\\gamma(u)&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-u^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\] \(F\) 是沿运动方向的电场力，\(u\) 是加速过程中的当前速度，\(t\) 是时间，\(c\) 是光速；\(\mathrm{d}u/\mathrm{d}t\) 表示速度的变化率，也就是加速度。这个方程由瞬时静止系中的力学规律，加上坐标和电磁场的相对论变换得到；这里把它作为有明确出处的输入。
text.en: The relativistic input is the longitudinal equation of motion \[\begin{aligned}F&=m\gamma(u)^3\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}t},\\\gamma(u)&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-u^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\] Here \(F\) is the electric force along the motion, \(u\) the current speed during acceleration, \(t\) time, and \(c\) the speed of light. The expression \(\mathrm{d}u/\mathrm{d}t\) is the rate of velocity change, or acceleration. This equation follows from the force law at instantaneous rest together with relativistic coordinate and field transformations; it is the sourced input to the calculation here.

heading.zh: 把每一小段做功累加起来
heading.en: Adding the work in small steps

text.zh: 怎样从力得到动能？你熟悉的“功等于力乘位移”仍是入口，只是速度变动时，力也会变化，所以要把过程分成很小的一段段。在短时间 \(\mathrm{d}t\) 内，位移是 \(\mathrm{d}x=u\,\mathrm{d}t\)，这段做功就是动能的微小增加 \(\mathrm{d}K\)。代入运动方程：\[\begin{aligned}\mathrm{d}K&=F\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=m\gamma(u)^3\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}t}\,u\,\mathrm{d}t\\&=m\gamma(u)^3u\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}\] 最后一行把每段做功改写成“速度增加一点时，动能增加多少”，便于从速度零一直累加到最终速度 \(v\)。
text.en: To obtain kinetic energy, start with the familiar rule that work is force times displacement. Because the force changes with speed, divide the acceleration into very small steps. In a short time \(\mathrm{d}t\), the displacement is \(\mathrm{d}x=u\,\mathrm{d}t\); the work is the small kinetic-energy increase \(\mathrm{d}K\). Substitution gives \[\begin{aligned}\mathrm{d}K&=F\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=m\gamma(u)^3\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}t}\,u\,\mathrm{d}t\\&=m\gamma(u)^3u\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}\] The last line expresses each contribution in terms of a small speed increase, ready to be accumulated from rest to the final speed \(v\).

text.zh: 先把根式写成 \(\gamma(u)=(1-u^2/c^2)^{-1/2}\)。求它的变化率时，用到一条微积分规则：复合函数的变化率等于“外层变化率乘内层变化率”。外层是负二分之一次幂，求导给出 \(-\tfrac12(1-u^2/c^2)^{-3/2}\)；内层 \(1-u^2/c^2\) 的变化率是 \(-2u/c^2\)。两者相乘，负号和因子 \(2\) 约去，便有 \[\begin{aligned}\frac{\mathrm{d}\gamma}{\mathrm{d}u}&=-\frac12\left(1-\frac{u^2}{c^2}\right)^{-3/2}\left(-\frac{2u}{c^2}\right)\\&=\left(1-\frac{u^2}{c^2}\right)^{-3/2}\frac{u}{c^2}\\&=\frac{\gamma(u)^3u}{c^2}.\end{aligned}\] 它的意思是，速度只增加极小的 \(\mathrm{d}u\) 时，\(\gamma\) 的增加为 \(\mathrm{d}\gamma=\gamma(u)^3u\,\mathrm{d}u/c^2\)。于是每小段动能增加可写成 \(\mathrm{d}K=mc^2\,\mathrm{d}\gamma\)。把这些小变化全部相加，就是积分：\[\begin{aligned}K(v)-K(0)&=mc^2\bigl[\gamma(v)-\gamma(0)\bigr]\\&=mc^2[\gamma(v)-1].\end{aligned}\] 这里 \(\gamma(0)=1\)，且把静止时的动能规定为 \(K(0)=0\)，便得到被引用的电子动能公式。
text.en: First write the square root as a negative power: \(\gamma(u)=(1-u^2/c^2)^{-1/2}\). Calculating its rate of change uses a calculus rule: for a composite function, multiply the outer rate of change by the inner rate of change. The outer negative-half power gives \(-\tfrac12(1-u^2/c^2)^{-3/2}\); the inner expression \(1-u^2/c^2\) changes at rate \(-2u/c^2\). Multiplying cancels the minus signs and the factors of \(2\): \[\begin{aligned}\frac{\mathrm{d}\gamma}{\mathrm{d}u}&=-\frac12\left(1-\frac{u^2}{c^2}\right)^{-3/2}\left(-\frac{2u}{c^2}\right)\\&=\left(1-\frac{u^2}{c^2}\right)^{-3/2}\frac{u}{c^2}\\&=\frac{\gamma(u)^3u}{c^2}.\end{aligned}\] It says that an infinitesimal speed increase \(\mathrm{d}u\) changes \(\gamma\) by \(\mathrm{d}\gamma=\gamma(u)^3u\,\mathrm{d}u/c^2\).
