Each energy increase is therefore \(\mathrm{d}K=mc^2\,\mathrm{d}\gamma\). Adding all these small changes is integration: \[\begin{aligned}K(v)-K(0)&=mc^2\bigl[\gamma(v)-\gamma(0)\bigr]\\&=mc^2[\gamma(v)-1].\end{aligned}\] Since \(\gamma(0)=1\) and kinetic energy at rest is set to \(K(0)=0\), this gives the cited electron kinetic-energy formula.

heading.zh: 相同的速度因子说明什么？
heading.en: What does the shared speed factor tell us?

text.zh: 短文中的另一条结果来自对称发光：物体速度不变，静止系的光带走 \(L\)，运动系的光带走 \(\gamma L\)；两系守恒配合共同零点的动能解释，得到 \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\)。因此可把两个结果排在一起：\[\begin{aligned}K&=mc^2(\gamma-1),\\K_0-K_1&=L(\gamma-1).\end{aligned}\] 相同的是速度如何进入公式，不同的是前面的能量系数，以及一个是单个状态的动能、另一个是两个状态的动能差。
text.en: The note’s other result comes from symmetric emission: the body keeps its speed, the light carries away \(L\) in the rest frame and \(\gamma L\) in the moving frame, and conservation with the common-offset kinetic-energy identification gives \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\). Thus the two results can be placed together: \[\begin{aligned}K&=mc^2(\gamma-1),\\K_0-K_1&=L(\gamma-1).\end{aligned}\] They share the way speed enters the formula. They differ in the energy coefficient and in whether the formula describes one kinetic energy or a difference between two states.

text.zh: 这个对应提示：可以在低速下，用熟悉的 \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\) 识别差值中的质量系数。这里引用的电子论证从质点模型出发；对于含内部结构的整个物体，仍需说明为什么其整体动能的低速系数就是惯性质量。这是比较式子时需要保留的对象范围。
text.en: The correspondence suggests identifying the mass coefficient of the difference at low speed, where \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\) is familiar. The cited electron argument starts from a point-particle model. For a whole body with internal structure, identifying the low-speed coefficient of overall kinetic energy with inertial mass still needs justification. That is the object-level scope of the comparison.

title.zh: 为什么比较低速时的平方项就能读出质量变化？
title.en: Why the low-speed squared term identifies a mass change

summary.zh: 低速动能中 \(v^2\) 的系数是惯性质量的一半。对称发光前后速度相同，把动能差的这个系数读出来，就得到质量减少 \(m_0-m_1=L/c^2\)。
summary.en: The coefficient of \(v^2\) in low-speed kinetic energy is half the inertial mass. Symmetric emission keeps the speed unchanged, so extracting that coefficient from the kinetic-energy difference gives a mass loss \(m_0-m_1=L/c^2\).

reasoning.zh: 展开 \[\begin{aligned}(1-x)^{-1/2}&=1+\frac x2\\&\quad+\frac{3x^2}{8}+\cdots\end{aligned}\]，取 \(x=\frac{v^2}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: Expand \[\begin{aligned}(1-x)^{-1/2}&=1+\frac x2\\&\quad+\frac{3x^2}{8}+\cdots\end{aligned}\] with \(x=\frac{v^2}{c^2}\).

reasoning.zh: 与 \(\frac12(m_0-m_1)v^2\) 的二阶系数比较，得到 \(m_0-m_1=\frac{L}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: Match the \(v^{2}\) coefficient of \(\frac12(m_0-m_1)v^2\) to obtain \(m_0-m_1=\frac{L}{c^2}\).

limits.zh: 小的是比较参考系的相对速度。对一般复合物体仍要说明上述低速动能系数为何是其惯性质量，不能只因 \(v\) 小就忽略内部相对论运动。
limits.en: The expansion concerns relative frame speed. For a composite body, one must still establish that this low-speed coefficient is its inertial mass; low translational speed alone does not remove relativistic internal motion.

why.zh: 经典力学把质量与 \(\tfrac12mv^2\) 联系起来；相对论差值 \(L(\gamma-1)\) 在低速下的首项是 \(Lv^2/(2c^2)\)。让速度趋近于零，较高次项的影响消失，同一差值的平方项系数便必须一致。
why.en: Classical mechanics connects mass with \(\tfrac12mv^2\). The leading low-speed term of \(L(\gamma-1)\) is \(Lv^2/(2c^2)\). As speed approaches zero, higher powers cease to affect the comparison, so the squared-term coefficients of the same energy difference must agree.

text.zh: 这里要识别的是惯性质量：同样的力推动时，物体有多难加速。低速力学用 \(F=ma\) 描述它，其中 \(F\) 是力、\(a\) 是加速度。若保持物体内部状态不变，从静止在恒力下加速，走过距离 \(s\) 后有 \(v^2=2as\)，所做的功便是 \[W=Fs=mas=\frac12mv^2.\] 功转为动能，所以低速动能中乘在 \(v^2\) 前面的数就是 \(m/2\)。寻找这个系数，是把能量计算接到“抵抗加速的质量”上的办法。
text.en: The quantity to identify is inertial mass: how difficult a body is to accelerate under a given force. Low-speed mechanics describes it by \(F=ma\), with force \(F\) and acceleration \(a\). Keep the internal state fixed and accelerate from rest under constant force. After distance \(s\), \(v^2=2as\), so the work is \[W=Fs=mas=\frac12mv^2.\] That work becomes kinetic energy, making the coefficient multiplying \(v^2\) equal to \(m/2\). Extracting this coefficient connects an energy calculation to mass as resistance to acceleration.

text.zh: 本题的输入结果是对称发光的动能差 \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L(\gamma-1),\\\gamma&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\] 它来自两系光能量的变换、各自的能量守恒，以及采用共同零点的整体动能解释。\(L\) 是物体静止系中的总发光能量，\(c\) 是光速，\(v\) 是另一位观察者相对物体的速度；\(K_0\)、\(K_1\) 是这位观察者看到的发光前后动能。由于对称发光没有反冲，两次比较中的 \(v\) 相同，而前后惯性质量 \(m_0\)、\(m_1\) 可以不同。
text.en: The input is the symmetric-emission kinetic-energy difference \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=L(\gamma-1),\\\gamma&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}.\end{aligned}\] It follows from transforming the light energy, conserving energy separately in both frames, and identifying whole-body kinetic energy with a common energy offset. Here \(L\) is total emitted energy in the body’s rest frame, \(c\) the speed of light, and \(v\) the other observer’s speed relative to the body. \(K_0\) and \(K_1\) are the before-and-after kinetic energies seen by that observer. Symmetric emission has no recoil, so both comparisons use the same \(v\), while the inertial masses \(m_0\) and \(m_1\) may differ.

heading.zh: 平方项为什么成为首项？
heading.en: Why does the squared term lead?

text.zh: 可以选择相对物体运动很慢的观察者，让 \(|v|\ll c\)。令 \(x=v^2/c^2\)，这个 \(x\) 是没有单位的小数。再乘一次 \(x\)，就得到更小的 \(x^2=v^4/c^4\)。因此把 \(\gamma\) 按 \(x\) 的幂整理时，\(x\) 项支配低速下的首个变化，\(x^2\) 项只是更小的修正。这就是原文“忽略四阶及更高阶”在此处的含义：四阶指 \(v/c\) 的四次方。
text.en: Choose an observer moving slowly relative to the body, so \(|v|\ll c\). Set \(x=v^2/c^2\), a small dimensionless number. Multiplying by another factor of \(x\) gives the still smaller \(x^2=v^4/c^4\). In an expansion of \(\gamma\) in powers of \(x\), the \(x\) term therefore supplies the leading low-speed change, with \(x^2\) giving a smaller correction. This explains the paper’s omission of fourth and higher orders: fourth order here means the fourth power of \(v/c\).

text.zh: 首项中的 \(1/2\) 可以用高中代数看出来，无需先掌握展开公式。先通分，再用共轭式 \(1+\sqrt{1-x}\) 同乘分子分母：\[\begin{aligned}\gamma-1&=\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x}}{\sqrt{1-x}}\\&=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1-x}\bigl(1+\sqrt{1-x}\bigr)}.\end{aligned}\] 当 \(x\) 很小时，分母趋近 \(1\times(1+1)=2\)，所以首项是 \(x/2\)。继续展开则得到 \(\gamma-1=x/2+3x^2/8+\cdots\)，与原文留下的二阶项一致。
text.en: The leading factor \(1/2\) can be seen with elementary algebra, before using an expansion formula. First combine the fractions, then multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate \(1+\sqrt{1-x}\): \[\begin{aligned}\gamma-1&=\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x}}{\sqrt{1-x}}\\&=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1-x}\bigl(1+\sqrt{1-x}\bigr)}.\end{aligned}\] As \(x\) becomes small, the denominator approaches \(1\times(1+1)=2\), giving the leading term \(x/2\). Continuing the expansion gives \(\gamma-1=x/2+3x^2/8+\cdots\), consistent with the second-order term retained in the paper.

text.zh: 代回光能计算得到 \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=\frac{L}{2c^2}v^2\\&\quad+\frac{3L}{8c^4}v^4+\cdots.\end{aligned}\] 同一差值，用前后惯性质量表示时，其低速首项是 \[\begin{aligned}&\frac12m_0v^2-\frac12m_1v^2\\&=\frac12(m_0-m_1)v^2.\end{aligned}\] 两个质量都乘同一个 \(v^2\)，是因为物体没有反冲；这样动能差才把质量的变化单独挑出来。
text.en: Substitution into the light-energy calculation gives \[\begin{aligned}K_0-K_1&=\frac{L}{2c^2}v^2\\&\quad+\frac{3L}{8c^4}v^4+\cdots.\end{aligned}\] Expressing the same difference through the before-and-after inertial masses gives the low-speed leading term \[\begin{aligned}&\frac12m_0v^2-\frac12m_1v^2\\&=\frac12(m_0-m_1)v^2.\end{aligned}\] Both masses multiply the same \(v^2\) because there is no recoil. That is what allows the kinetic-energy difference to isolate the mass change.

text.zh: 精确的系数比较，是先在 \(v\ne0\) 时把同一个动能差除以 \(v^2\)，再让 \(v\) 趋近于零。这样 \(v^4\) 项除过之后还含 \(v^2\)，最终消失，保留下来的是 \[\begin{aligned}\lim_{v\to0}\frac{K_0-K_1}{v^2}&=\frac12(m_0-m_1)\\&=\frac{L}{2c^2}.\end{aligned}\] 因而 \(m_0-m_1=L/c^2\)。这里比较的是同一函数在低速极限中的首项系数；有限小速度时仍有高阶修正，而极限把识别质量所需的系数准确分离出来。
text.en: To compare the coefficients precisely, divide the same kinetic-energy difference by \(v^2\) at nonzero \(v\), then let \(v\) approach zero. A \(v^4\) term still contains \(v^2\) after division and vanishes in that limit. What remains is \[\begin{aligned}\lim_{v\to0}\frac{K_0-K_1}{v^2}&=\frac12(m_0-m_1)\\&=\frac{L}{2c^2}.\end{aligned}\] Hence \(m_0-m_1=L/c^2\). The comparison concerns the leading coefficient of the same function in the low-speed limit. A small finite speed retains higher-order corrections; the limit isolates the mass coefficient exactly.

text.zh: 所取的小速度是整个物体相对观察者的平移速度。对复杂物体，内部各部分仍可能运动很快，场和维持平衡的应力也会参与整体能量，因此还需要证明整个系统的低速动能系数就是其惯性质量。Laue 对与外界无相互作用的完整静态系统提供了这种整体依据。低速代数解决了如何读出系数，物体的完整性和内部状态则决定这项质量解释的适用条件。
text.en: The small speed is the translation of the whole body relative to the observer. In a composite body, internal parts may still move rapidly, and fields and supporting stresses contribute to the overall energy. Identifying the whole system’s low-speed kinetic-energy coefficient with inertial mass therefore needs a whole-system justification. Laue supplies this for complete static systems without external interaction. The low-speed algebra extracts the coefficient, while completeness and internal state determine the conditions for its mass interpretation.

title.zh: 为什么发出能量会使质量减少？
title.en: Why does releasing energy reduce mass?

summary.zh: 在本文的对称发光过程中，物体每失去静止时测得的能量 \(L\)，质量就减少 \(L/c^2\)。关键是：发光前后速度相同，动能却减少了；低速时，这个差只能体现为质量系数的减少。
summary.en: In the paper's symmetric emission process, losing rest-frame energy \(L\) reduces the body's mass by \(L/c^2\). The crucial observation is that its speed stays the same while its kinetic energy falls; at low speed this appears as a smaller mass coefficient.

reasoning.zh: 由 t-low-speed 得 \(m_0-m_1=\frac{L}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: Use t-low-speed to obtain \(m_0-m_1=\frac{L}{c^2}\).

reasoning.zh: 按发射后减发射前定义变化，得到 \(\Delta m=\frac{E_1-E_0}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: Define the change as final minus initial, giving \(\Delta m=\frac{E_1-E_0}{c^2}\).

limits.zh: 这里的 \(L\) 在发射体静止系测量。有限运动参考系的总能量含有动能，不能直接与同一个静止质量写成 \(E=mc^2\)。
limits.en: \(L\) is measured in the emitter-rest frame. Total energy in a moving frame includes kinetic energy and cannot be equated to the same rest mass times \(c^{2}\) without the Lorentz factor.

limits.zh: 仅由差值关系得到 \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}=mc^2+\text{常数}\)；绝对零点及一般闭合系统的关系要另行处理。
limits.en: A differences-only relation gives \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}=mc^2\) plus a constant; the absolute zero and the relation for general closed systems need separate treatment.

label.en: Combined result of the independent 2005 test

interpretation.zh: 最终Nature文的报告值；在其不确定度内与零相容。具体核反应、常数及仪器条件见实验支链。
interpretation.en: The final Nature value is compatible with zero within its uncertainty. Reactions, constants and instrument conditions are specified in the experimental branch.

label.zh: 同一研究线的版本数字略有不同

detail.zh: Dewey方法预印本Table IX为\(-1.21(4.33)\times 10^{-7}\)；Nature最终论文为\(-1.4(4.4)\times 10^{-7}\)。本例按版本分别记录，最终检验采用后者。
detail.en: Dewey preprint Table IX reports \(-1.21(4.33)\times 10^{-7}\); final Nature reports \(-1.4(4.4)\times 10^{-7}\). They remain versioned; the final test uses the latter.

why.zh: 用两个匀速相对运动的观察者分别计算同一次发光的能量收支，便能求出动能减少量；再与熟悉的 \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\) 比较，就能读出质量减少多少。
why.en: Energy conservation for the same emission, described by two uniformly moving observers, determines the kinetic-energy loss. Comparing it with the familiar \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\) then identifies the mass loss.

text.zh: 这里的“质量”指惯性质量：在低速力学中，它既决定同样的力能产生多大的加速度，也出现在动能公式 \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\) 中。因此，要判断一个物体的质量是否改变，可以比较它在同一速度下、两种状态的动能。把发光前后的质量记为 \(m_0,m_1\)，相应动能记为 \(K_0,K_1\)，低速时便有 \(K_0-K_1\approx\tfrac12(m_0-m_1)v^2\)。目标是从光带走的能量，独立算出这个动能差。
text.en: Here mass means inertial mass: in low-speed mechanics it determines the acceleration produced by a force and appears in \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\). We can therefore investigate a change of mass by comparing two states of the body at the same speed. Write \(m_0,m_1\) for its masses before and after emission, and \(K_0,K_1\) for the corresponding kinetic energies. At low speed, \(K_0-K_1\approx\tfrac12(m_0-m_1)v^2\). The task is to calculate this difference independently from the emitted energy.

text.zh: 为避免把质量变化和速度变化混在一起，Einstein安排物体同时向相反方向各发出能量 \(L/2\)。两边作用对称，物体发光前后都在原观察者那里静止。另一位相对原观察者以速度 \(v\) 匀速运动的观察者，则看到物体前后始终具有相同的速率 \(v\)。这里 \(v\) 是两个观察者的相对速度，\(c\) 是真空光速；\(L>0\) 表示发出的总能量，由与物体一起静止的观察者测量。
text.en: To keep a mass change separate from a speed change, Einstein makes the body emit \(L/2\) simultaneously in each of two opposite directions. The symmetric emission leaves the body at rest for the original observer. A second observer moving uniformly at speed \(v\) relative to the first sees the body at the same speed \(v\) both before and after. Thus \(v\) is the observers' relative speed, \(c\) is the vacuum speed of light, and \(L>0\) is the total emitted energy measured by the observer at rest with the body.

text.zh:
还需要一个相对论输入：同一批光，在运动观察者那里测得的总能量为 \(\gamma L\)，其中 \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\)。这来自本文所引用的此前论文第8节的光能变换；两束反向光各自有与方向有关的增减项，求和时这些项相消，留下共同的因子 \(\gamma\)。它表达的是同一过程在两个参考系中的不同能量读数。现在令 \(E_0,E_1\) 为静止观察者测得的物体发光前后能量，\(H_0,H_1\) 为运动观察者测得的对应能量。各自使用能量守恒，得到
\[\begin{aligned}
E_0-E_1&=L,\\
H_0-H_1&=\gamma L.
\end{aligned}\]
text.en:
One relativistic input is needed: the moving observer measures total light energy \(\gamma L\), where \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\). This comes from the light-energy transformation in §8 of the earlier paper cited here. Each opposite beam has a direction-dependent correction; those corrections cancel in the sum, leaving the common factor \(\gamma\). These are different energy readings for the same event in two frames. Let \(E_0,E_1\) denote the body's before-and-after energies for the rest observer, and \(H_0,H_1\) those for the moving observer. Conservation in each frame gives
\[\begin{aligned}
E_0-E_1&=L,\\
H_0-H_1&=\gamma L.
\end{aligned}\]

text.zh:
将第二式减去第一式，是为了留下“由于整体运动而多出的能量”如何改变：
\[\begin{aligned}
(H_0-E_0)-(H_1-E_1)&=L(\gamma-1).
\end{aligned}\]
原文把同一内部状态的运动能量与静止能量之差写为 \(H-E=K+C\)。其中 \(K\) 是整体运动的动能，\(C\) 只是两套能量读数选择零点时留下的固定差额。发光前后沿用同一个零点，两个 \(C\) 相消，于是 \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\)。这一步采用了原文对整体动能的识别；对包含许多部件的物体，需要把内部能量以及维持平衡的拉力、压力一并纳入完整系统，后来的理论才把这些条件处理得更明确。
text.en:
Subtract the first equation from the second to isolate the change in energy associated with overall motion:
\[\begin{aligned}
(H_0-E_0)-(H_1-E_1)&=L(\gamma-1).
\end{aligned}\]
For a fixed internal state, the paper identifies the moving-minus-rest energy as \(H-E=K+C\). Here \(K\) is the kinetic energy of overall motion, and \(C\) is a fixed offset arising from the chosen energy zeros. Using the same zeros before and after makes the two offsets cancel, giving \(K_0-K_1=L(\gamma-1)\). This step adopts the paper's identification of bulk kinetic energy. For a composite body, internal energy and the tensions and pressures maintaining equilibrium must all belong to the complete system; later theory makes those conditions explicit.

text.zh:
接下来把比较速度 \(v\) 选得远小于 \(c\)，以便使用低速动能公式。所需近似可以用基础代数看出来：将根式有理化，
\[\begin{aligned}
\gamma-1
&=\frac{v^2/c^2}
{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\bigl(1+\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\bigr)}\\
&\approx\frac{v^2}{2c^2}.
\end{aligned}\]
因为 \(v^2/c^2\) 很小，分母中的两个根式都接近1，整个分母接近2。因此，同一个动能差有两种表达：
\[\begin{aligned}
K_0-K_1&\approx\frac{Lv^2}{2c^2},\\
K_0-K_1&\approx\frac12(m_0-m_1)v^2.
\end{aligned}\]
取非零但越来越小的 \(v\)，两式同除以 \(v^2/2\)，它们的低速系数必须一致，便得到 \(m_0-m_1=L/c^2\)。这识别的是质量系数本身；选择低速观察者不要求发出的光也很慢。
text.en:
Choose the comparison speed \(v\) much smaller than \(c\), so that low-speed kinetic energy can be used. Elementary algebra explains the required approximation. Rationalizing the square root gives
\[\begin{aligned}
\gamma-1
&=\frac{v^2/c^2}
{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\bigl(1+\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\bigr)}\\
&\approx\frac{v^2}{2c^2}.
\end{aligned}\]
When \(v^2/c^2\) is small, each square root in the denominator approaches 1, so the denominator approaches 2. The same kinetic-energy difference therefore has two descriptions:
\[\begin{aligned}
K_0-K_1&\approx\frac{Lv^2}{2c^2},\\
K_0-K_1&\approx\frac12(m_0-m_1)v^2.
\end{aligned}\]
For nonzero \(v\) approaching zero, divide both expressions by \(v^2/2\). Their limiting coefficients must agree: \(m_0-m_1=L/c^2\). This identifies the mass coefficient itself. Choosing a slow observer does not require the emitted light to move slowly.

text.zh: 注意正负号：\(L\) 是正的“放出量”，所以质量减少量 \(m_0-m_1=L/c^2\) 也是正的。若“变化量”统一定义为发光后减发光前，则 \(\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}=-L\)、\(\Delta m=-L/c^2\)，仍满足 \(\Delta m=\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}/c^2\)。下标 rest 提醒我们，这里比较的是物体整体静止时的能量。
text.en: The signs matter. Since \(L\) is the positive amount emitted, the mass loss \(m_0-m_1=L/c^2\) is positive too. If a change is instead defined as after minus before, then \(\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}=-L\) and \(\Delta m=-L/c^2\), still giving \(\Delta m=\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}/c^2\). The subscript rest specifies energy measured with the body as a whole at rest.

heading.zh: 怎样用实验检查这个结论
heading.en: How an experiment checks the conclusion

text.zh:
实验检验需要分别量出能量和质量，而后比较。2005年的硅、硫中子俘获实验中，原子核吸收中子后放出高能电磁辐射，即γ射线。研究者由离子在磁场中的回旋频率求质量差，由辐射波长求能量，并计入有关修正。为了消去中子质量，他们将硅或硫的俘获过程与氢俘获中子形成氘的过程相减。用 \(M\) 表示原子质量，\({}^{A}X\) 和 \({}^{A+1}X\) 表示俘获前后的硅或硫原子，H、D分别表示氢和氘，则实际比较的质量组合是
\[
\Delta m=M({}^{A}X)-M({}^{A+1}X)+M(\mathrm D)-M(\mathrm H).
\]
它是两项质量亏损之差；对应的 \(E\) 也是硅或硫的中子俘获结合能减去氘结合能。这里 \(\Delta m\) 与 \(E\) 均为正，且属于同一组差值比较。若质能关系符合测量，应有 \(\Delta mc^2/E=1\)，因此偏差 \(1-\Delta mc^2/E=0\)。最终论文报告
\[
1-\frac{\Delta mc^2}{E}=(-1.4\pm4.4)\times10^{-7}.
\]
\(-1.4\times10^{-7}\) 是测得偏差的中心值，\(\pm4.4\times10^{-7}\) 是所报告的不确定度。预测的零值在这一范围内，所以这项以氢、氘为参照的比较在该精度下与质能关系相容。这项证据发表于1905年之后。
text.en:
An experimental test measures energy and mass separately and then compares them. In the 2005 silicon and sulphur neutron-capture experiments, a nucleus absorbed a neutron and emitted high-energy electromagnetic radiation, or gamma rays. Ion cyclotron frequencies supplied mass differences; radiation wavelengths supplied energies, with the relevant corrections. To eliminate the neutron mass, the researchers subtracted the hydrogen-to-deuterium capture process from the silicon or sulphur capture process. Let \(M\) denote atomic mass, \({}^{A}X\) and \({}^{A+1}X\) the silicon or sulphur atoms before and after capture, and H and D hydrogen and deuterium. The mass combination actually compared is
\[
\Delta m=M({}^{A}X)-M({}^{A+1}X)+M(\mathrm D)-M(\mathrm H).
\]
This is the difference between two mass deficits. The matching \(E\) is likewise the silicon or sulphur neutron-capture binding energy minus the deuterium binding energy. Here \(\Delta m\) and \(E\) are both positive and belong to the same difference comparison. Agreement requires \(\Delta mc^2/E=1\), hence a deviation \(1-\Delta mc^2/E=0\). The final paper reports
\[
1-\frac{\Delta mc^2}{E}=(-1.4\pm4.4)\times10^{-7}.
\]
The measured central deviation is \(-1.4\times10^{-7}\); \(\pm4.4\times10^{-7}\) is the reported uncertainty. The predicted zero lies within that range, so this hydrogen/deuterium-referenced comparison agrees with the relation at this precision. This evidence postdates the 1905 paper.

title.zh: 为何能从发光推广到其他能量？
title.en: Why extend the result beyond emitted light?

summary.zh: 能量对完整物体惯性的贡献，可以超出发光这一种过程。1905年短文提出了这一推广；已核读的后续证明明确覆盖处于静态平衡、与外界无相互作用的完整系统。
summary.en: Energy's contribution to a complete body's inertia extends beyond light emission. The 1905 note proposes this generalization; the inspected later proof explicitly covers complete systems in static equilibrium without external interaction.

reasoning.zh: 原文计算给出一种能量移出方式的 \(\Delta m=\frac{\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: The displayed calculation gives \(\Delta m=\frac{\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\) for one mode of energy removal.

reasoning.zh: 推广要求各种储能及约束装置属于同一完整系统；不能只选其中的辐射、气体或电场而漏掉支撑应力。
reasoning.en: Extension requires all energy stores and constraints to belong to the complete system; radiation, gas, or field subsystems must not omit supporting stresses.

reasoning.zh: Laue §5 的能量—动量积分在完整静态系统上给出 \(E=\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}\) 与 \(p=\frac{\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}v}{c^2}\)，支持 \(m=\frac{E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: Laue §5 integrates energy and momentum for a complete static system to give \(E=\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}\) and \(p=\frac{\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}v}{c^2}\), supporting \(m=\frac{E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\).

limits.zh: 原文的一般结论、原文实际展示的过程、后续理论证明是三个不同证据层级。Laue 1911 不可能是 1905 原文引用。
limits.en: The general assertion, the displayed process, and the later proof are distinct evidence layers. Laue 1911 cannot be a citation in the 1905 note.

label.zh: 后续研究对论证范围有争论
label.en: Later debate about the argument’s scope

detail.zh: Ohanian认为一般扩展物体的内运动与应力处理需要补充。这是已核读论文的批评；其提及的Stachel–Torretti辩护原文尚未取得，争论双方的论证读取尚不对称。
detail.en: Ohanian calls for additional treatment of internal motion and stresses. This is his inspected critique; the Stachel–Torretti defense he cites remains unavailable, leaving asymmetric access to the debate.

why.zh: 推广时必须把储能的部分和维持它们平衡的部分一起计算。这样，物体的总能量才能与作为一个整体运动时的动能正确衔接。
why.en: The energy-storing parts and the parts maintaining their equilibrium must be counted together. This connects the system's total energy correctly to its kinetic energy when it moves as a whole.

text.zh: 原文已经算过的具体情形是：一个物体同时向相反方向发出等量光，整体速度保持不变，静止时测得的能量减少 \(L\)，质量减少 \(L/c^2\)。答案只含能量 \(L\) 和光速 \(c\)，没有材料种类或发光方向。这给了Einstein一个推广线索：决定质量效应的可能是物体失去多少能量，而不是能量离开后恰好成为光。这就是本句走出的那一步。
text.en: The specific process calculated in the note is symmetric emission: a body sends equal light energies in opposite directions, keeping its overall velocity unchanged. It loses rest-frame energy \(L\) and mass \(L/c^2\). The answer contains energy \(L\) and light speed \(c\), but no material type or emission direction. That suggests Einstein's extension: the mass effect may depend on how much energy leaves the body, rather than on its becoming light afterward. This sentence makes that extension.

text.zh: 但一个有内部结构的物体，需要先说清“物体”包括什么。可以用被支架卡住的压缩弹簧来理解：弹簧储存弹性势能，支架承受它的推力。若只把弹簧算作系统，支架的作用力就来自系统外部；若把弹簧和支架一起纳入，才有机会得到一个自身保持平衡的整体。相对论中，这些内部的拉力和压力——统称应力——也进入整体能量与运动的计算。因此，仅仅说“各种能量都一样”还不足以替代完整系统的处理。这个例子用于说明系统边界，不是论文报告的一次弹簧实验。
text.en: For a structured body, we must first say what the body includes. Imagine a compressed spring held by a support. The spring stores elastic energy, while the support bears its force. If only the spring is counted, the support exerts an external force on the selected system. Including both allows a self-balanced whole. In relativity, these internal tensions and pressures—called stresses—also enter the calculation of total energy and motion. Treating all forms of energy alike therefore requires a complete-system calculation. The spring illustrates the boundary choice; it is not an experiment reported in the paper.

text.zh:
Laue在1911年的推导提供了这样的后续支持。他把机械与电磁的能量、动量和应力一起计算，要求系统在静止时处于静态平衡，且外边界不与外界相互作用。完整推导使用相对论场论和积分；这里把其结论作为已说明条件的输入：一个总静止能量为 \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}\) 的系统，以速度 \(v\) 运动时，总能量为 \(E_{\mathrm{moving}}=\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}\)，其中 \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\)。减去静止能量，就得到整体运动所增加的动能：
\[\begin{aligned}
K&=E_{\mathrm{moving}}-E_{\mathrm{rest}}\\
&=(\gamma-1)E_{\mathrm{rest}}\\
&\approx\frac12\frac{E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}v^2
\qquad (v\ll c).
\end{aligned}\]
与低速公式 \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\) 比较，质量系数便是 \(m=E_{\mathrm{rest}}/c^2\)。结果直接联系完整系统的储能和惯性，不必要求系统正在发光。
text.en:
Laue's 1911 derivation supplies this later support. It includes mechanical and electromagnetic energy, momentum and stresses, requiring static equilibrium in the rest frame and no external interaction at the boundary. The full proof uses relativistic field theory and integration. Here its result is an input with explicit conditions: a system of total rest energy \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}\), moving at speed \(v\), has total energy \(E_{\mathrm{moving}}=\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}\), where \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\). Subtracting rest energy gives the energy added by overall motion:
\[\begin{aligned}
K&=E_{\mathrm{moving}}-E_{\mathrm{rest}}\\
&=(\gamma-1)E_{\mathrm{rest}}\\
&\approx\frac12\frac{E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}v^2
\qquad (v\ll c).
\end{aligned}\]
Comparison with \(K=\tfrac12mv^2\) identifies \(m=E_{\mathrm{rest}}/c^2\). This directly connects the complete system's stored energy with inertia, without requiring it to be emitting light.

text.zh: 这也说明该如何理解原文的“更普遍”：1905年展示了对称发光的计算，并提出更宽的结论；上述后续证明补上了完整静态系统的条件。随时间发生变化的任意系统，还需要更一般的理论处理。已核读的Ohanian论文讨论的正是原推导对内部运动和应力处理是否充分；这是一项有具体对象的争论，不能只凭本句的“显然”替它作结。
text.en: This clarifies the scope of “more general.” The 1905 calculation treats symmetric emission and proposes a broader conclusion; the later proof supplies explicit conditions for complete static systems. Arbitrary time-dependent systems require a more general treatment. The inspected Ohanian paper questions whether the original argument adequately handles internal motion and stresses. That is a specific dispute about scope, which the word “evidently” in this sentence does not settle.

title.zh: 质量对应的是物体静止时的总能量
title.en: Mass corresponds to total energy at rest

summary.zh: 这里的“所含能量”指物体整体静止时的总能量，包括内部储能。1905年的演算先得到质量与这份能量的变化关系；完整静态系统的后续理论进一步给出 \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}=mc^2\)。
summary.en: “Energy-content” here means the body's total energy when it is at rest as a whole, including internal energy. The 1905 calculation first relates changes in this energy and mass; later theory for complete static systems gives \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}=mc^2\).

reasoning.zh: 原文计算给出一种能量移出方式的 \(\Delta m=\frac{\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: The displayed calculation gives \(\Delta m=\frac{\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\) for one mode of energy removal.

reasoning.zh: 推广要求各种储能及约束装置属于同一完整系统；不能只选其中的辐射、气体或电场而漏掉支撑应力。
reasoning.en: Extension requires all energy stores and constraints to belong to the complete system; radiation, gas, or field subsystems must not omit supporting stresses.

reasoning.zh: Laue §5 的能量—动量积分在完整静态系统上给出 \(E=\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}\) 与 \(p=\frac{\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}v}{c^2}\)，支持 \(m=\frac{E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: Laue §5 integrates energy and momentum for a complete static system to give \(E=\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}\) and \(p=\frac{\gamma E_{\mathrm{rest}}v}{c^2}\), supporting \(m=\frac{E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\).

limits.zh: 原文的一般结论、原文实际展示的过程、后续理论证明是三个不同证据层级。Laue 1911 不可能是 1905 原文引用。
limits.en: The general assertion, the displayed process, and the later proof are distinct evidence layers. Laue 1911 cannot be a citation in the 1905 note.

why.zh: 换一个运动观察者，会额外看到物体整体运动的动能。质量所对应的静止能量把这一观察者相关的运动贡献单独分了出来。
why.en: A moving observer also sees kinetic energy from the body's overall motion. Rest energy separates out that observer-dependent contribution.

text.zh: 一个物体整体静止，并不等于它没有能量。它仍可储存热、化学能或弹性势能；“静止”只说整体没有平移。把这一状态的总能量记作 \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}\)，其中 rest 就是“静止”的意思。原文的发光计算比较的是这种能量：与物体一起静止的观察者测得它失去 \(L\)，质量减少 \(L/c^2\)。因此，质量既与惯性有关，也能反映内部能量改变。
text.en: A body can be at rest as a whole while still storing thermal, chemical or elastic energy. “At rest” refers to its overall translation. Write its total energy in that condition as \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}\). The emission calculation compares this energy: an observer at rest with the body measures a loss \(L\), accompanied by a mass loss \(L/c^2\). Mass therefore reflects changes in internal energy as well as describing inertia.

text.zh:
还要区分“两个状态差多少”和“一个状态的总量是多少”。令下标0、1表示两种状态，变化关系可以改写为
\[\begin{aligned}
E_{\mathrm{rest},1}-E_{\mathrm{rest},0}
&=(m_1-m_0)c^2,\\
E_{\mathrm{rest},1}-m_1c^2
&=E_{\mathrm{rest},0}-m_0c^2.
\end{aligned}\]
可见，仅由差值能确定的是 \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}-mc^2\) 保持为同一个常数；它还没有决定这个常数的值。这类似于知道两地的高度差，还需要规定从哪里算零。后来的完整系统理论在明确的能量与动量定义下，才进一步建立这里使用的 \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}=mc^2\)。
text.en:
We must distinguish the difference between two states from an absolute total. Let 0 and 1 label two states. The change relation can be rearranged as
\[\begin{aligned}
E_{\mathrm{rest},1}-E_{\mathrm{rest},0}
&=(m_1-m_0)c^2,\\
E_{\mathrm{rest},1}-m_1c^2
&=E_{\mathrm{rest},0}-m_0c^2.
\end{aligned}\]
Differences alone say that \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}-mc^2\) is a common constant; they do not determine its value. Knowing the height difference between two places similarly leaves the zero level unspecified. Later complete-system theory, with explicit definitions of energy and momentum, establishes the relation used here, \(E_{\mathrm{rest}}=mc^2\).

text.zh:
如果另一个观察者看到这个完整静态系统以速度 \(v\) 运动，已核读的理论给出
\[\begin{aligned}
E_{\mathrm{moving}}&=\gamma mc^2,\\
K&=E_{\mathrm{moving}}-E_{\mathrm{rest}}
=(\gamma-1)mc^2,
\end{aligned}\]
其中 \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\)，\(c\) 为光速，\(K\) 是整体动能。同一个内部状态的静止质量 \(m\) 没变，增加的是这个观察者测到的动能。因此，阅读“质量是能量的量度”时，需要同时读出“哪一种能量”：对应 \(mc^2\) 的是静止能量，运动时的总能量还包含 \(K\)。
text.en:
For an observer who sees this complete static system moving at speed \(v\), the inspected theory gives
\[\begin{aligned}
E_{\mathrm{moving}}&=\gamma mc^2,\\
K&=E_{\mathrm{moving}}-E_{\mathrm{rest}}
=(\gamma-1)mc^2,
\end{aligned}\]
where \(\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}\), \(c\) is light speed and \(K\) is bulk kinetic energy. The rest mass \(m\) of the same internal state is unchanged; the observer measures additional kinetic energy. Thus “mass measures energy” requires specifying which energy: \(mc^2\) corresponds to rest energy, while a moving-frame total also includes \(K\).

title.zh: 为什么用尔格和克会得到 \(9\times10^{20}\)？
title.en: Why do ergs and grams give \(9\times10^{20}\)?

summary.zh: \(9\times10^{20}\) 是以厘米/秒表示的近似光速的平方。能量用尔格（erg）计时，除以这个数，单位正好化成克。
summary.en: \(9\times10^{20}\) is the square of the rounded light speed in centimetres per second. Dividing an energy in ergs by this value gives a mass in grams.

reasoning.zh: 原文先给\(\Delta m=\frac{L}{c^2}\)，再说\(L\)用erg、质量用克。\(1\,\mathrm{erg}=1\,\mathrm{g}\cdot\mathrm{cm}^2/\mathrm{s}^2\)。
reasoning.en: The note first gives \(\Delta m=\frac{L}{c^2}\), then specifies ergs and grams. One erg is one \(\mathrm{g}\cdot\mathrm{cm}^2/\mathrm{s}^2\).

reasoning.zh: 由\(9\times 10^{20}\)还原出所用近似\(c\approx3\times10^{10}\,\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}\)，再平方得到分母。这个光速数值并未在短文中单独列出。
reasoning.en: The denominator implies the rounded \(c\approx3\times10^{10}\,\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}\). Squaring it gives \(9\times 10^{20}\); the speed itself is not separately stated.

reasoning.zh: 历史光学测量支持这一数量级；现代SI定义可用于精确换算，两者的角色不同。
reasoning.en: Historical optical measurements support the rounded scale; modern SI supplies an exact conversion, a different evidential role.

limits.zh: 数字換算核查的是单位和算术；质量与能量之间的物理关系仍由理论推导及实验支持。
limits.en: This check establishes units and arithmetic; the physical mass–energy relation needs theoretical and experimental support.

interpretation.zh: 英文保留历史排法\(L/9\times10^{20}\)；中文按\(\frac{L}{c^2}\)显式补出整个分母的括号。
interpretation.en: The English retains the historical typography \(L/9\times10^{20}\); Chinese makes the denominator explicit using \(\frac{L}{c^2}\).

interpretation.zh: 1905取整所得质量变化比现代换算小约\(0.1383\%\)，是取整差异。
interpretation.en: The historical rounded mass conversion is about \(0.1383\%\) smaller than the modern one.

why.zh: 能量的单位包含“质量×速度平方”；除以 \(c^2\)，长度和时间单位消去，剩下的就是质量单位。
why.en: An energy unit contains mass times speed squared. Dividing by \(c^2\) cancels the length and time factors, leaving a mass unit.

text.zh: 先把物理关系与单位选择分开。这里采用的关系是 \(\Delta m=\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}/c^2\)：\(\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}\) 为物体静止能量的“后减前”，\(\Delta m\) 为质量的“后减前”。光速 \(c\) 的平方为正，因此能量增加时质量增加，能量减少时质量减少，这就是原文“沿同一方向变化”的意思。现在的问题只是：选择尔格、克、厘米、秒来记数后，这个式子长什么样？
text.en: Start with the physical relation \(\Delta m=\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}/c^2\). Both \(\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}\) and \(\Delta m\) mean after minus before. Since \(c^2\) is positive, energy gain accompanies mass gain, and energy loss accompanies mass loss: this explains “changes in the same sense.” The remaining question concerns numerical units—what does the equation become when energy is in ergs and mass, length and time are in grams, centimetres and seconds?

text.zh:
为什么一尔格等于 \(\mathrm{g\,cm^2/s^2}\)？从高中力学就能找到单位来源：功等于力乘位移，力等于质量乘加速度；加速度的单位是长度/时间平方。所以能量的单位是
\[
\text{质量}\times\frac{\text{长度}}{\text{时间}^2}
\times\text{长度}
=\frac{\text{质量}\times\text{长度}^2}{\text{时间}^2}.
\]
采用克、厘米、秒时，这个能量单位称为尔格，记为erg，即 \(1\,\mathrm{erg}=1\,\mathrm{g\,cm^2/s^2}\)。
text.en:
Why is one erg \(\mathrm{g\,cm^2/s^2}\)? Elementary mechanics supplies the units: work is force times displacement, force is mass times acceleration, and acceleration has units of length divided by time squared. Energy therefore has units
\[
\text{mass}\times\frac{\text{length}}{\text{time}^2}
\times\text{length}
=\frac{\text{mass}\times\text{length}^2}{\text{time}^2}.
\]
With grams, centimetres and seconds, this energy unit is the erg: \(1\,\mathrm{erg}=1\,\mathrm{g\,cm^2/s^2}\).

text.zh:
原文分母相当于采用 \(c\approx3\times10^{10}\,\mathrm{cm/s}\)。平方时，数值与单位都要平方：
\[
c^2\approx9\times10^{20}\,\mathrm{cm^2/s^2}.
\]
沿用发光过程的约定，\(L>0\) 表示以erg计的放出能量数值；把发光前、后的质量分别记为 \(m_0,m_1\)。现在计算的是正的“质量减少量”：
\[\begin{aligned}
m_0-m_1
&=\frac{L\,\mathrm{g\,cm^2/s^2}}
{9\times10^{20}\,\mathrm{cm^2/s^2}}\\
&=\frac{L}{9\times10^{20}}\,\mathrm g.
\end{aligned}\]
上下的 \(\mathrm{cm^2/s^2}\) 抵消，剩下g。整个 \(9\times10^{20}\) 都在分母中。若使用首段“后减前”的变化量，则 \(\Delta m=m_1-m_0=-L/(9\times10^{20})\,\mathrm g\)，负号表示质量减少。这个近似光速是从分母还原出来的，短文没有另行写出该数值。
text.en:
The denominator corresponds to \(c\approx3\times10^{10}\,\mathrm{cm/s}\). Squaring means squaring both the number and its unit:
\[
c^2\approx9\times10^{20}\,\mathrm{cm^2/s^2}.
\]
Keep the emission convention: \(L>0\) is the numerical amount of energy emitted in ergs. Let \(m_0,m_1\) be the masses before and after emission. We are now calculating the positive mass loss:
\[\begin{aligned}
m_0-m_1
&=\frac{L\,\mathrm{g\,cm^2/s^2}}
{9\times10^{20}\,\mathrm{cm^2/s^2}}\\
&=\frac{L}{9\times10^{20}}\,\mathrm g.
\end{aligned}\]
The factors \(\mathrm{cm^2/s^2}\) cancel, leaving grams. The whole \(9\times10^{20}\) is the denominator. With the opening paragraph's after-minus-before convention, \(\Delta m=m_1-m_0=-L/(9\times10^{20})\,\mathrm g\); the minus sign denotes a decrease. This approximate light speed is inferred from the denominator; the note does not separately state it.

text.zh: 这个取整值与1905年前光学测量得到的光速数量级相符。现代SI单位制则把真空光速固定为 \(299792458\,\mathrm{m/s}\)；用这个精确数值换算，所得质量变化比原文取整结果略大，原文系数小约 \(0.1383\%\)。这是光速取整造成的数值差异。单位消去说明换算合理，质能关系本身的物理理由来自另列的推导与实验。
text.en: The rounded value agrees in scale with optical measurements made before 1905. Modern SI fixes vacuum light speed at \(299792458\,\mathrm{m/s}\). Using that exact value produces a slightly larger mass change: the historical rounded coefficient is smaller by about \(0.1383\%\). This is a rounding difference. Unit cancellation establishes the conversion; the physical relation itself rests on the separately explained derivation and experiments.

title.zh: 怎样知道镭盐在持续放出热量？
title.en: How do we know radium salts keep releasing heat?

summary.zh: 镭盐持续放热已有直接测量支持：样品保持温度较高，同时向外散热，且量热计持续收到热量。但这些热量测量尚未给出质量亏损，也未单独确定热量来自哪里。
summary.en: Direct measurements support continuous heating by radium salts: the sample stays warmer while losing heat, and a calorimeter continues receiving heat. These measurements did not establish a mass deficit or uniquely determine the energy source.

reasoning.zh:
等形安瓿中的含镭盐与纯氯化钡用铁—康铜热电偶比较：含镭盐高约\(1.5\,{}^\circ\mathrm{C}\)；两份纯氯化钡对照仅约\(0.01\,{}^\circ\mathrm{C}\)。
用已知电流和电阻的加热丝复现相同稳态温差来定量热功率；另以Bunsen量热计复核，加入样品后汞柱匀速移动，移除后停止。
1克混盐约14小卡/小时，估计约\(\frac{1}{6}\)质量为氯化镭，另测\(0.08\)克纯氯化镭。两法同量级而非精确一致；每克镭约100小卡/小时是量级估计。
原文没有统计误差条；混盐成分不精确。末页仍讨论未知外部能量这一替代解释，因此此文支持持续放热及量级，尚未完成质能关系检验。
reasoning.en:
Iron–constantan thermocouples compared matching ampoules: radium-containing salt was about \(1.5\,{}^\circ\mathrm{C}\) warmer; two inactive controls differed by only about \(0.01\,{}^\circ\mathrm{C}\).
A heater of known current and resistance reproduced the steady temperature difference. Independent Bunsen calorimetry showed steady mercury motion with the sample, stopping on removal.
One gram of mixed salt gave about 14 cal/hour, with roughly one-sixth radium chloride; \(0.08\,\mathrm{g}\) of pure chloride was also tested. Methods agreed in scale, not exactly.
Composition was approximate and no statistical error bar was supplied. The authors still entertained unknown external energy, so this establishes heating and scale, not mass–energy equivalence.

limits.zh: 原文没有统计误差条；混盐成分不精确。末页仍讨论未知外部能量这一替代解释，因此此文支持持续放热及量级，尚未完成质能关系检验。
limits.en: Composition was approximate and no statistical error bar was supplied. The authors still entertained unknown external energy, so this establishes heating and scale, not mass–energy equivalence.

label.zh: 支持了观测，尚未完成能量来源解释
label.en: Observed heating, with an unresolved source interpretation

detail.zh: 不能把“镭盐持续放热”直接改写成“该量热实验已验证质能关系”。这一步正是被引用背景与主张之间需要留下的差距。
detail.en: Continuous heating must not be rewritten as a calorimetric verification of mass–energy equivalence. This is the gap between the observed background and the stronger claim.

quantities.calculation:
Mixed sample: \(\approx14\,\text{small cal}/\text{hour}\) for \(1\,\mathrm{g}\)
Radium chloride fraction: \(\approx\frac16\) by mass

interpretation.zh: 原作者给出量级，没有统计误差条；混盐、氯化镭与每克镭不能混成同一个归一化单位。
interpretation.en: This is an estimated scale without statistical error bars. Mixed salt, radium chloride and elemental-radium normalization are distinct.

why.zh: 一个比周围温暖的样品会散热。若其温度不再下降，就必须有持续的能量供应补偿；再用已知电加热功率复现同样温差，就能估算这份供应有多大。
why.en: A sample warmer than its surroundings loses heat. If its temperature remains steady, an ongoing energy supply must replace that loss. Reproducing the same temperature difference with known electrical heating estimates the supply rate.

text.zh: “温度较高”和“持续放热”之间，需要补上一个能量收支理由。一个先被加热、后来不再获得供热的样品，会逐渐冷却；持续保持高于周围的温度，则说明它一边散热，一边得到补偿。把使样品温度升降的那部分热能记作 \(U_{\mathrm{th}}\)，在一段时间内有 \(\Delta U_{\mathrm{th}}=Q_{\mathrm{supply}}-Q_{\mathrm{out}}\)：\(Q_{\mathrm{supply}}\) 是热源补进这部分的能量，\(Q_{\mathrm{out}}\) 是向外散出的热量。达到温度基本不再变化的“稳态”时，\(\Delta U_{\mathrm{th}}\approx0\)，所以 \(Q_{\mathrm{supply}}\approx Q_{\mathrm{out}}\)。只要仍有热量流出，供热就必须持续。此时保持稳定的是温度所反映的热能；热源自身的储能仍可能减少。
text.en: A higher temperature needs an energy-balance argument before it becomes evidence of continuous heating. A previously heated sample with no further heating gradually cools. If it remains warmer than its surroundings, ongoing heat loss must be replenished. Denote the thermal-energy part associated with its temperature by \(U_{\mathrm{th}}\). Over a time interval, \(\Delta U_{\mathrm{th}}=Q_{\mathrm{supply}}-Q_{\mathrm{out}}\): \(Q_{\mathrm{supply}}\) is energy supplied to this thermal part, and \(Q_{\mathrm{out}}\) is heat lost. In a steady state, meaning approximately constant temperature, \(\Delta U_{\mathrm{th}}\approx0\), so \(Q_{\mathrm{supply}}\approx Q_{\mathrm{out}}\). Continued heat loss therefore requires continued heating. The temperature-related thermal part stays steady; the energy reservoir supplying the heat may still decrease.

text.zh: Curie与Laborde用相同形状的小安瓿比较含镭盐和纯氯化钡，并将它们放在相同的隔热环境中。读温差的仪器是铁—康铜热电偶，它把两个接点的温度差转成可测电信号。含镭样品高约 \(1.5\,{}^\circ\mathrm C\)；换成两份纯氯化钡时，差别仅约 \(0.01\,{}^\circ\mathrm C\)。这个空白对照用于检查：在相同外界条件和容器条件下，装置本身会造成多大的温差。
text.en: Curie and Laborde compared radium-containing salt with pure barium chloride in matching ampoules under matching insulation. An iron–constantan thermocouple converts the temperature difference between two junctions into an electrical signal. The radium-containing sample was about \(1.5\,{}^\circ\mathrm C\) warmer. With pure barium chloride in both ampoules, the difference was only about \(0.01\,{}^\circ\mathrm C\). This blank comparison checks how much difference the apparatus produces under the same environmental and container conditions.

text.zh: 要从温差得到“每小时多少热量”，还需要标定。研究者用电阻丝在同一装置中供热，调节电流，直到复现含镭样品造成的稳态温差。相同装置、相同温差下，向外散热的功率相同；稳态又要求供热功率等于散热功率，因此电阻丝需要提供的功率就是样品的供热功率。电功率可以由 \(P=I^2R\) 算出，\(I\) 是电流，\(R\) 是电阻，\(P\) 表示单位时间内提供的能量。这是用一个能直接计算的热源，来标定未知热源。
text.en: Converting a temperature difference into heat per hour requires calibration. The researchers supplied heat with a resistance wire in the same apparatus, adjusting the current until it reproduced the steady temperature difference caused by the radium sample. With the same apparatus and temperature difference, heat escapes at the same rate. In steady state, supply equals loss, so the required electrical heating power equals the sample's heating power. Electrical power is calculated from \(P=I^2R\): \(I\) is current, \(R\) resistance and \(P\) energy supplied per unit time. A calculable heat source thus calibrates the unknown one.

text.zh: 另一种Bunsen量热法把收到的热量转成汞柱位移。放入样品后汞柱匀速移动，取出后停止，提供了不同仪器下的持续热输入证据。原研究对1克混盐测得约14小卡/小时，再依据镭含量估计出每克镭约100小卡/小时的量级。这里分母“每克镭”很重要：混盐总质量、氯化镭质量和其中镭元素的质量不是同一个量。样品成分只是近似已知，两种量热法的结果也并非精确一致，因此100是量级估计，原文没有给出统计误差条。
text.en: A second method, Bunsen calorimetry, converted received heat into mercury-column displacement. The column moved uniformly with the sample present and stopped when it was removed, supporting continued heat input with a different instrument. The study measured about 14 small calories per hour from one gram of mixed salt, then used its estimated radium content to obtain a scale of about 100 small calories per gram of radium per hour. The denominator matters: total mixed salt, radium chloride and elemental radium are different mass quantities. Composition was approximate and the two methods did not agree exactly, so 100 is a scale estimate without a reported statistical error bar.

text.zh: 这些观测解释了Einstein为何会想到镭盐：它能在可观测的时间内持续给出能量。不过，量热仪器回答的是“有多少热流出”。1903年原作者仍讨论过未知外部能量这一替代解释；要把热量进一步对应到物体自身的质量减少，还需要独立的质量测量与完整的能量收支。
text.en: These observations explain why Einstein considered radium salts: they supply energy continuously on an observable timescale. Calorimetry, however, answers how much heat emerges. The 1903 authors still considered an unknown external energy source. Connecting that heat to a decrease in the body's own mass requires independent mass measurements and complete energy accounting.

title.zh: 镭盐为什么被提议用来检验？
title.en: Why propose radium salts for a test?

summary.zh: 镭盐持续释放能量，因此被提出作为检验材料：能量变化越大，预测的质量差 \(L/c^2\) 也越大。原句是在提出可尝试的实验方向。
summary.en: Radium salts continuously release energy, making them a proposed test material: a larger energy change predicts a larger mass difference \(L/c^2\). The sentence proposes an experimental possibility.

reasoning.zh: 原句用“可能”提出材料选择与检验方向。
reasoning.en: The sentence proposes a material and possible experimental direction.

reasoning.zh: 已有的放热量热测量可以解释该建议的动机；短文中没有称量数据或误差预算。
reasoning.en: Existing heating measurements motivate it; the note supplies neither weighing data nor an uncertainty budget.

limits.zh: 后来的核反应检验可检验质能关系，但它不是这里所建议的镭盐称量实验。
limits.en: Later nuclear-reaction tests probe the relation but are not the proposed radium-salt weighing experiment.

why.zh: 验证这条关系，要把独立测得的质量差与能量变化相比较。明显的能量释放有助于获得更大的待测信号。
why.en: Testing the relation requires comparing independently measured mass and energy changes. Pronounced energy release provides a larger predicted signal.

text.zh: 本文的预测是：物体若在自身静止时放出正的能量 \(L\)，质量应减少 \(L/c^2\)，其中 \(c\) 是真空光速。因为要除以一个很大的 \(c^2\)，从有限能量变化得到的质量信号会很小。选择能持续释放较多能量的材料，是提高这个信号的合理方向；当时已有的镭盐量热观测提供了这种材料线索。
text.en: The prediction is that a body releasing positive energy \(L\), measured at rest with it, loses mass \(L/c^2\), where \(c\) is vacuum light speed. Division by the large \(c^2\) makes the mass signal small. A material that continuously releases substantial energy offers a route to a larger signal, and contemporary radium calorimetry supplied that clue.

text.zh: 怎样才算检验？需要一边测量能量变化，一边独立测量同一过程的质量差，再看两者是否按 \(c^2\) 联系起来。仅仅量出热量并代入 \(L/c^2\)，得到的是理论预测的质量差；还需要实际质量测量与它比较，并判断测量精度是否足够。1905年短文在这里给出了材料与方向，没有给出这项称量检验的数据或精度方案，因此原句保留了“或许可能”的语气。
text.en: What would constitute a test? Measure the energy change and independently measure the mass difference for the same process, then compare them using \(c^2\). Measuring heat and inserting it into \(L/c^2\) produces a predicted mass difference; an actual mass measurement must be compared with that prediction at adequate precision. The 1905 note supplies a material and direction here, but no weighing data or precision plan. That explains its tentative wording.

title.zh: 光怎样把惯性效应从一个物体传给另一个？
title.en: How can light transfer an inertial effect between bodies?

summary.zh: 光把能量从发射体带到吸收体；若这份能量改变了它们的静止能量，就会相应改变它们的惯性质量。实际吸收若带来整体运动，还需要分出那部分动能。
summary.en: Light carries energy from an emitter to an absorber. Changes in their rest energies then produce corresponding changes in inertial mass. If absorption also sets a body moving, that kinetic energy must be accounted for separately.

reasoning.zh: 发射过程使用 \(\Delta m=\frac{\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\)。
reasoning.en: Apply \(\Delta m=\frac{\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}}{c^2}\) to emission.

reasoning.zh: 吸收过程把进入系统的能量纳入最终静止能量；若发生反冲，还须把动能和动量一并核算。
reasoning.en: For absorption, account for incoming energy in the final rest energy; recoil requires including kinetic energy and momentum.

limits.zh: 原短文未列出吸收实验数据，也未逐式推导一个有反冲的吸收过程。这里的“转移惯性”不等于宣称单个光子的静止质量非零。
limits.en: The note supplies no absorption data and no stepwise recoiling-absorber calculation. Transfer of inertia does not assert nonzero photon rest mass.

why.zh: 质量与静止能量满足同一个变化关系，所以能量转移会在发射端体现为质量减少，在吸收端体现为所保留静止能量对应的质量增加。
why.en: The same relation connects changes in mass and rest energy: an emitter loses mass, while an absorber gains the mass corresponding to the added energy retained as rest energy.

text.zh: “惯性”指改变物体运动有多困难。低速时 \(F=ma\)：同样的力 \(F\) 作用在质量 \(m\) 更大的物体上，加速度 \(a\) 更小。本文将这种惯性质量与静止能量联系为 \(\Delta m=\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}/c^2\)。若发射体像文中的对称发光装置那样保持静止，放出能量 \(L>0\)，它的静止能量减少 \(L\)，惯性质量便减少 \(L/c^2\)。这就是“传递惯性”在发射端的含义。
text.en: Inertia describes how difficult it is to change a body's motion. At low speed, \(F=ma\): the same force \(F\) gives a smaller acceleration \(a\) to a larger mass \(m\). The paper connects this inertial mass to rest energy through \(\Delta m=\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}/c^2\). If the emitter remains at rest, as in the symmetric emission setup, releasing \(L>0\) reduces its rest energy by \(L\) and its inertial mass by \(L/c^2\). This is the emitter side of “conveying inertia.”

text.zh:
到了吸收端，关键是光的能量最终留在哪里。若能量全部作为完整吸收系统的内部能量保留下来，而系统前后都整体静止，则增加的静止能量除以 \(c^2\) 就是质量增量。若吸收使物体后退或开始运动，这种运动称为反冲；输入能量的一部分成为整体动能。对一个最初静止的吸收体，记输入光能为 \(L_{\mathrm{in}}\)，最终反冲动能为 \(K_{\mathrm{recoil}}\)，能量记账为
\[\begin{aligned}
L_{\mathrm{in}}&=\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}+K_{\mathrm{recoil}},\\
\Delta m&=\frac{L_{\mathrm{in}}-K_{\mathrm{recoil}}}{c^2}.
\end{aligned}\]
因此有反冲时，必须同时处理能量和动量，才能知道多少能量真正增加了静止质量。
text.en:
At the absorber, the key question is where the light's energy ends up. If all of it remains as internal energy of the complete absorbing system, with that system at rest before and after, the mass gain is the added rest energy divided by \(c^2\). Absorption may instead set the body moving; this is recoil, and some incoming energy becomes bulk kinetic energy. For an initially stationary absorber, let \(L_{\mathrm{in}}\) be incoming light energy and \(K_{\mathrm{recoil}}\) its final recoil kinetic energy. Then
\[\begin{aligned}
L_{\mathrm{in}}&=\Delta E_{\mathrm{rest}}+K_{\mathrm{recoil}},\\
\Delta m&=\frac{L_{\mathrm{in}}-K_{\mathrm{recoil}}}{c^2}.
\end{aligned}\]
A recoiling process therefore requires both energy and momentum accounting to identify the increase in rest mass.

text.zh: 所以，原句描述的是一个物理后果：能量从一端流向另一端，相关物体的惯性也随之改变。它保留“如果理论符合事实”这一条件，并未在短文中另做吸收实验或完整的反冲推导。这里的质量效应属于发射体和吸收体的静止能量变化；不应把 \(L/c^2\) 直接称为单个光子的静止质量。
text.en: The sentence thus describes a physical consequence: as energy passes between bodies, their inertia changes accordingly. It retains the condition that the theory agree with facts; the note adds neither an absorption experiment nor a complete recoil derivation. The mass effect here concerns changes in the bodies' rest energies. \(L/c^2\) should not be identified as the rest mass of an individual photon.

title.zh: 麦克斯韦方程怎样给出光速？
title.en: How do Maxwell's equations give light speed?

summary.zh: 麦克斯韦真空方程描述电场和磁场如何共同传播，给出的波速是 \(c\)。要让所有匀速观察者都得到同一个 \(c\)，还需采用正文的相对性原理。
summary.en: Vacuum Maxwell equations describe how electric and magnetic fields propagate together, at speed \(c\). The relativity principle in the text is also needed to apply the same \(c\) to every uniformly moving observer.

reasoning.zh: Maxwell 1865 自己的单位下得到 \(V=\sqrt{\frac{k}{4\pi\mu}}\)；与上式是单位和记号不同的表达。
reasoning.en: In Maxwell’s 1865 units the result is \(V=\sqrt{\frac{k}{4\pi\mu}}\); this is a different units-and-notation expression.

limits.zh: Maxwell 方程在一个系中给出传播速度；每个惯性系都采用同一形式，还用到了相对性原理。这里只处理真空，不套用于介质中的相速度。
limits.en: Maxwell equations specify propagation speed in a frame; using the same form in every inertial frame also requires relativity. This branch concerns vacuum, not a material medium’s phase velocity.

why.zh: 将电场和磁场的两条变化规律合并，会得到只含一个场的波动方程；检查满足它的移动波形，便能读出传播速度。
why.en: Combining the electric and magnetic evolution laws gives a wave equation for one field. Examining a moving shape that satisfies it identifies the propagation speed.

text.zh: 推导从“无电荷、无电流的真空中，场服从麦克斯韦方程”这一物理前提出发。先取一个容易画出的情形：光沿 \(x\) 方向传播，电场沿 \(y\) 方向、磁场沿 \(z\) 方向；同一垂直截面上的场相同，这叫平面波。把电场沿所选方向的分量写为 \(E(x,t)\)，磁场分量写为 \(B(x,t)\)：它们随位置 \(x\) 和时刻 \(t\) 而变。特别注意，这一栏的 \(E\) 表示电场，不是文章其他公式里的能量。
text.en: The physical starting point is that fields in a charge-free, current-free vacuum obey Maxwell's equations. Consider a simple geometry: light travels along \(x\), with its electric field along \(y\) and magnetic field along \(z\). The fields are uniform across each perpendicular plane—a plane wave. Write the field components as \(E(x,t)\) and \(B(x,t)\): their values depend on position \(x\) and time \(t\). In this panel, \(E\) means electric field, not the energy denoted by \(E\) elsewhere in the paper.

text.zh:
先解释方程里“偏导数”的读法。\(\partial E/\partial t\) 表示固定一个位置，看电场每单位时间改变多少；可以把它理解为相邻两次读数之差除以时间间隔，再把间隔取得越来越小。\(\partial B/\partial x\) 则固定同一时刻，看相邻位置的磁场变化有多陡。\(\partial\) 这个符号提醒我们：只改变一个变量，另一个保持不变。对上述平面波，选择使两式共用系数 \(c\) 的Gaussian电磁单位后，麦克斯韦方程可写为
\[\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial E}{\partial t}&=-c\frac{\partial B}{\partial x},\\
\frac{\partial B}{\partial t}&=-c\frac{\partial E}{\partial x}.
\end{aligned}\]
它们说的是：电场如何随时间变化，取决于附近磁场如何随位置变化；磁场也受电场的空间变化约束。\(c\) 是这套真空方程里的速度常数。
text.en:
First, read a partial derivative as a rate of change. \(\partial E/\partial t\) holds position fixed and asks how fast the electric field changes: think of the difference between nearby readings divided by their time interval, with the interval made progressively smaller. \(\partial B/\partial x\) holds time fixed and measures the spatial slope of the magnetic field. The symbol \(\partial\) reminds us to vary one variable while holding the other fixed. For this plane wave, Gaussian electromagnetic units give the two laws a common coefficient \(c\):
\[\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial E}{\partial t}&=-c\frac{\partial B}{\partial x},\\
\frac{\partial B}{\partial t}&=-c\frac{\partial E}{\partial x}.
\end{aligned}\]
The electric field's time change is tied to the magnetic field's spatial variation, and conversely. Here \(c\) is the speed constant in the vacuum equations.

text.zh:
为什么它意味着波速是 \(c\)？设一幅形状为 \(F\) 的波以待定速度 \(u\) 平移，写成 \(E(x,t)=F(x-ut)\)。\(F\) 只是描述波形的函数；时刻增加时，读数取自它的不同位置。每求一次时间变化率，输入 \(x-ut\) 会带来一个因子 \(-u\)，求两次便得到 \(u^2\)；对位置求两次则没有这个因子。因此，代入波动方程后，非平直波形要求 \(u^2=c^2\)，即传播速度的大小为 \(c\)，可朝正、反两个方向。以正向传播的 \(F(x-ct)\) 为例，同一波峰总对应同一个输入值，所以
\[\begin{aligned}
x-ct&=\text{常数},\\
(x+\Delta x)-c(t+\Delta t)&=x-ct,\\
\Delta x&=c\,\Delta t.
\end{aligned}\]
这最后一式直接说：经过时间 \(\Delta t\)，波峰前进 \(c\Delta t\)，速度就是 \(c\)。
text.en:
Why does this mean speed \(c\)? Suppose a shape \(F\) translates at an unknown speed \(u\): \(E(x,t)=F(x-ut)\). The function \(F\) describes the shape; advancing time samples a different position within it. Each time derivative introduces a factor \(-u\) from the input \(x-ut\), so two introduce \(u^2\). Two position derivatives have no such factor. Substitution into the wave equation therefore requires \(u^2=c^2\) for a curved waveform: speed magnitude \(c\), in either direction. For a forward-moving shape \(F(x-ct)\), the same crest always has the same input value:
\[\begin{aligned}
x-ct&=\text{constant},\\
(x+\Delta x)-c(t+\Delta t)&=x-ct,\\
\Delta x&=c\,\Delta t.
\end{aligned}\]
The last line says directly that in time \(\Delta t\), the crest advances \(c\Delta t\), hence at speed \(c\).

text.zh: 最后才是“光速对谁相同”。上述计算说明：在使用这套真空方程的参考系中，波以 \(c\) 传播。正文另采用相对性原理，要求彼此匀速直线运动的惯性系使用相同的物理定律；惯性系可以理解为没有加速或转动的理想观察者所使用的坐标系。既然另一位这样的观察者也使用同一组真空方程和同样的常数，就会同样求出波速 \(c\)。因此，这条脚注的完整读法是“真空电磁方程给出波速，相对性原理把同一形式的定律应用到各惯性系”。这里的讨论范围是真空传播。
text.en: Finally, for whom is the speed the same? The calculation establishes propagation at \(c\) in a frame using these vacuum equations. The text separately adopts relativity: inertial frames moving uniformly in straight lines relative to one another use the same physical laws. An inertial frame is the coordinate system of an ideal observer without acceleration or rotation. Another such observer therefore uses the same vacuum equations with the same constants and obtains the same speed \(c\). Read together, the footnote and the main text say that vacuum electromagnetism fixes the wave speed, while relativity applies the same laws across inertial frames. This discussion concerns vacuum propagation.

evidence.locator: §2, first postulate

finding.zh: 定律在彼此匀速平移的惯性系中保持同一形式，是这条推导链的出发前提；它让能量守恒与真空电磁定律可在两个参考系中同时使用。
finding.en: The same laws apply in inertial frames related by uniform translation. This premise permits energy conservation and vacuum electromagnetism to be used in both frames.

Choose two inertial frames with relative velocity \(v\).
Require the laws describing the same process to have the same form.
The 1905 note does not experimentally re-establish the relativity principle; physical premises must be displayed separately from algebraic consequences.
